rows.text: Attack — a quick swing at whoever is right in front of you (short reach). On hit: 2.5%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.

Ember Column — throws up a slanting column of embers a little ahead of him; it tips whoever it lifts forward and up, where they hang a moment, ready for more (medium reach). On hit: 4.4%, sets them burning.
Fire Line — runs a line of fire straight along the floor a long way ahead; it shoves them back flat (medium reach). On hit: 3.6%, sets them burning.
Flame Wheel — wheels a ring of flame round over his head from behind him down to ahead of him, once; it slings them off flat (short reach). On hit: 4.4%, sets them burning.
Flame Jet — jets a big ball of flame a fair way ahead of him; it bursts under whoever it reaches and lifts them (medium reach). On hit: 6%, sets them burning.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Flashover — a burst of flame shoots up and back behind him, lifting whoever is there up and away; his strongest air hit, and he is open a while after it (medium reach). On hit: 7.2%.
Hot Head — flares his head straight up through whoever is close above (short reach). On hit: 4%.
Meteor Cinder — drops like a burning cinder: the very tip spikes whoever is below, the rest only pops them up; he is open a while after it (short reach). On hit: 8% at the tip (4.5% elsewhere).
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Singe, 2.2%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Singe — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2.2%.
Hot Potato — tosses them ahead like a hot potato, smoking. On hit: 7%.
Cinder Heave — spins and flings them behind him in a shower of sparks. On hit: 7.4%.
Flame Geyser — lifts them on a jet of flame, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.8%.
Scorch Mark — pins them to the floor and scorches them, leaving them down. On hit: 4.6%.
Ember Spit — spits a fireball that arcs forward (medium reach). On hit: 8%, sets them burning.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Flare Up — you rise inside a column of flame that drags foes beside you up with you, then bursts at the top, launching them and setting them burning, and your next X hits for much more damage (it launches like a plain one). On hit: small hits on the way up, then 5%.
Fire Hazard — leaves a patch of fire at your feet for 7 seconds; anyone who steps in it gets hit. On hit: 4%, sets them burning.

Lunge · Incinerator Blast — lunges forward (medium reach) and hits the first foe it touches. On hit: 21%, sets them burning. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Hang Glider Heave — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): snaps his hang glider open over his head: the nose hits hardest and the wings catch anyone off to the sides, high up. On hit: 17.5%. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Twin Torches — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): two tongues of flame shoot up and out from his feet in a V, low close in and head high at the ends. On hit: 14.5%, burns them.

Wildfire Flame Jets — stamps, then three flame jets burst up one after another along the floor ahead, each licking up out of the floor for a moment first (it hurts no one until it bursts); the last one launches. Step aside. On hit: 6% each, sets them burning.

Reflector — hold Z: a pane in front of you turns enemy shots back at their owner, 1.8x faster and 1.3x the damage (at most 12%). It takes 7 frames from the press to come up, lasts up to 36 while Z is held, and leaves you open for 22 frames after (then 30 more before you can raise it again). It does nothing against melee or grabs. The strong fighters have this instead of a shield. Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Total Firey Island — Columns of fire erupt out from under him both ways, burning whoever they hit.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. Hothead Rush can be jump-cancelled when it ends. No cling.
Attack — a quick punch right in front of you (short reach). On hit: 3%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Leaf Whip — whips her leaves up over her head (short reach). On hit: 3.5%.
Slide Kick — slides forward and kicks the feet out from under them (short reach). On hit: 3%.
Leaf Spin — spins her leaves round her, clipping everything near twice (short reach). On hit: 3%.
Flying Punch — a quick punch ahead in the air (short reach). On hit: 5%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Back Kick — kicks out behind her; the heel at the end hits harder (short reach). On hit: 7.5% with the heel (5.7% closer in).
Up Kick — kicks straight up (short reach). On hit: 3.5%.
Heel Drop — drops her heel on whoever is under her (short reach). On hit: 5.5%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Chart Flick, 1.6%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Chart Flick — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 1.6%.
Nice Try — shoves them ahead with a smile. On hit: 5%.
Backhand Kindness — turns and flicks them behind her. On hit: 5.5%.
Lift Up — hoists them up and lets go. On hit: 4%.
Niceness Chart — slaps the Niceness Chart down on them. On hit: 3.5%.
BFDIA Sprint — dashes forward (long reach), untouchable the whole way; anyone you run into takes the hit. On hit: 10%.
The neutral special, aimed that way.
Sprint Up — no hit: you blink straight up, untouchable for a moment. Hold left or right too and it becomes a BFDIA Sprint angled upward instead.
Kindness Parry — no hit: a half-second stance; whoever hits you in it is countered and takes at least 12%.

Volley · Run-Around — sprints one tight loop round the spot in front of her and stops where she started: anyone on the loop or inside it is swept off their feet once (she can be hit the whole time; it does nothing behind her). On hit: 16.5%, knocks them down. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Yoyleland Knife — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): throws one knife hard up and forward at a steep slant, a thin straight line about 100 px long from her hand: nothing straight overhead and nothing behind her. On hit: 13.7%, makes them bleed. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Falling Leaf — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): sways down like a falling leaf, a U that starts behind her and comes up in front: the back half carries a foe under her, the front half launches them the way she faces. On hit: 14.2%.

Leaf Whirl Slipstream — spins up a whirl of leaves that gathers for a moment, then sweeps 350 px ahead along the floor, carrying whoever it catches; the fourth hit flings them. Jump it. On hit: 4 hits of 2%.

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Into the Starry Void — Evil Leafy swallows a foe whole and lashes them in a starry void.

Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. DASH TECH (Celeste's), CAPTURE THE FLAG ONLY: there, out of a ↓ + → dash along the ground, jump for a HYPER (long, low, 1.4x the dash's speed); out of a straight dash, a SUPER (normal height, the dash's speed); with the other arrow held, a short reverse hyper. A ↓ + → dash from the air that lands is a wavedash: jump at once for a hyper. In every other mode a jump out of a dash is a plain jump. One air dash an airtime, refilled on landing. Sprint Leap can be jump-cancelled when it ends. No cling: she already has the Sprint.
Attack — three quick pricks just in front of you (short reach); the third one launches. On hit: 3 hits of 2%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Darning Rise — darns up and forward in a thin slanting line (medium reach). On hit: 4.1%.
Ankle Prick — pricks low, far along the floor, at their ankles (short reach). On hit: 2.8%, leaves them bleeding.
Needle Storm — spins her point round her, pricking everything near again and again (short reach). On hit: 1.3% a prick.
Thread Thrust — lunges forward on a thread, point first (short reach). On hit: 5.2%.

Rising Stitch — stitches straight up with her point (short reach). On hit: 3.8%.
Sewing Drop — drops point-first like a needle through cloth, and leaves a bleeding wound (short reach). On hit: 6.6%, leaves them bleeding.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Prick, 1.6%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.

Pulled Thread — yanks them along on a thread and lets go ahead of her. On hit: 6%.

Needle Toss — flicks them up off her point, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.2%.
Pincushion — pins them to the floor like a pincushion, bleeding. On hit: 4%.
The Reflex — no hit: a stance for under half a second; a hit on you in it does a quarter as much, and the attacker is pricked for 60% of it.

The Point — a split second on guard: get hit in it and the hit does nothing, you spring up extra high and prick them back; if nothing comes, you leap up with a rising jab (short reach), the tip hurting most. On hit: 8% and they bleed (the counter), or 9% (4% point-blank), leaves them bleeding.
The Reflex — no hit: the same stance held a little longer, about half a second; a hit on you does a quarter, and the attacker is pricked for 60% of it.

Riposte Stance — no hit at all: a stance, and whoever hits her during it gets hit back much harder Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Don't Call Me Needy! — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): the slap, swung from straight ahead up to straight overhead at arm's length: stuns for a moment. On hit: 8.2%, stuns them. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Double Stitch — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): stabs the floor and two needles come up through it, one each side, like a stitch through cloth: they pop foes upward (nothing right against her). On hit: 7.6%, bleeds them.

Thread the Needle — whips her thread straight ahead and reels the first foe it touches into a point-blank thrust; a catch stitches her a patch that halves the next hit. On hit: 12%, sets them bleeding.

It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Cut in Half — One long thin cut slices along the floor through everyone it meets.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. Thread Run can be jump-cancelled when it ends. No cling.
Attack — a quick poke just in front of her (short reach). On hit: 2.9%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Hop and Point — hops up, thrusting her point up and forward over whoever is in front (medium reach). On hit: 6.9%.
Low Prick — pricks along the floor at their feet, far out in front (medium reach). On hit: 5%.
Pinwheel — spins like a pinwheel, her point pricking everything round her three times over (short reach). On hit: 4.4%.
Prick Flurry — pricks again and again straight ahead, a rapid string of tiny hits (medium reach). On hit: 2.3%.

Skewer Up — thrusts her point straight up, hardest at the tip (medium reach). On hit: 8.5% at the tip (5.8% elsewhere).
Pin Drop — dives point-first and pins whoever is below to the floor; she can jump out of it once it hits (medium reach). On hit: 9.9%, roots them.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Prick, 3.5%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Prick — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 3.5%.
Pinned Toss — skewers them and tosses them ahead. On hit: 8.3%.
Flip Over — flips them over her point, behind her. On hit: 8.8%.
Skewer Up — skewers them and thrusts them up, ready for an up-air. On hit: 5.7%.
Pin Down — pins them to the floor by the point. On hit: 6.2%.
Point Pierce — steps in with a big point-first poke (short reach); inflatable foes like Balloony take 20% extra. On hit: 11.4%.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Pinned — she shoots up like a thrown pin, very fast and far: straight up, or steeply toward the side you hold; no steering once she goes. Her point hits hardest and pins them. After it she falls helpless (no jump or attack) until she lands. On hit: 9.4% (4.2% off the point), roots them in place.
Super Armour — no hit: braces for about two-thirds of a second; hits on her do less damage and barely push her.

Trap · Get to the Point! — plants her feet and holds her point straight out in front for two-thirds of a second (a thin line 70 px ahead at chest height): a foe who walks onto it takes less, one who dashes, falls or is thrown onto it takes more; she cannot move while she holds it. On hit: 23.4%, makes them bleed. Press V once: it charges for 0.5 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Flat Top — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): bucks her wide flat head upward with a small hop: a low flat plate just over her that rises with her. On hit: 20.3%. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Wobbling Top — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): spins on her point like a top and wanders, forward, back, forward: a light hit each way and a launch on the last leg. On hit: 18.7%.

Corkboard Slam — raises a corkboard and slams it down ahead, pinning a foe under it. Hold back while it is raised to slam it down behind you. It stands 4 s, stopping enemy shots and pinning anyone launched into it. On hit: 9.4%, pinned 0.5 s.

It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Popped — Climbs into a giant mech suit and stomps all over a foe.
Short hop, fast fall and wall jumps. CLINGS to a wall for about 1.1 s (her point sticks) before she slides. Pin Drop and Pin Leap jump-cancel.
Attack — a quick hit right in front of you (short reach). On hit: 3.2%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Snow Heave — heaves a great heap of snow up in a wide arc from behind him to over his head, armoured as he winds up (medium reach). On hit: 7.4%.
Snow Boulder — rolls a heavy boulder of snow along into their shins, carrying him with it; they hang a beat, ready for an up-air (short reach). On hit: 6.3%.
Snow Spin — curls up and rolls on the spot for a long moment, bumping everything round him again and again (short reach). On hit: 4.2%.
Snow Slam — slams a great lump of snow forward, far ahead, armoured as it winds up (medium reach). On hit: 10%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Snow Fling — flings a great heap of snow up and back behind him in a wide arc; his heaviest hit (medium reach). On hit: 11%.
Snow Plume — throws a tall plume of snow straight up from his top, far overhead; it carries them off the top (medium reach). On hit: 6.8%.
Avalanche — comes down like an avalanche and shoves everything under him out to the sides; he can jump out of it once it hits (short reach). On hit: 10%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Pack, 3.3%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Pack — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 3.3%.
Snowball Toss — packs them into a ball and tosses them ahead. On hit: 8.9%.
Roll Off — rolls them up and off behind him. On hit: 9.5%.
Snow Lift — heaves them up out of a drift, ready for an up-air. On hit: 5.8%.
Pack Down — packs them down into the snow. On hit: 6.3%.
Rage Tackle — you charge forward with armour (medium reach), running over whoever you meet. On hit: 10.5%.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Cold Clock — hold C to wind up the uppercut (you sink slowly), let go and you leap up with it: the longer the wind-up, the higher you go and the harder it hits; fully wound, it goes by itself. It hits hardest up close (short reach). On hit: about half for a quick one, up to 5.3% (11.6% up close) fully wound, slows them.
Dig In — no hit: you plant your feet with armour for almost a second, so hits hurt less and barely move you.

Shockwave · Ground Pound — a shockwave bursts out around you (medium reach) after a short wind-up (in the air, you slam down first). On hit: 19%, freezes them once they are above 15%. Breaks shields. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Up You Go — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): heaves both fists from his chest to overhead, in front of him, and throws the foe over his shoulder: one short thick hit that sends them up and BEHIND him (a foe straight behind him is missed). On hit: 15.8%. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Roll Out — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): stamps in a rage and a snowball rolls away from him on each side, growing as it goes: weak and small beside him, big and strong at the end of its run. On hit: 14.2%, the far ball leaves them slippery.

The Snowball Effect — grabs the foe in front, packs them into a snowball and bowls it ahead (hold back while you pack it to bowl it the other way); it grows as it rolls, flattening anyone in its path. The foe it holds can wriggle out by mashing, and is let go after three quarters of a second at most. On hit: 6.3% (the rolling snowball: 6.3% to 12.6%, knocks them down).

Avalanche — Sends one huge snowball ahead through everyone, then two small ones behind it.
Short hop, fast fall and wall jumps. CLINGS to a wall for about 0.8 s (the snow packs on) before he slides. Avalanche and Snow Roll jump-cancel; Snow Roll keeps its speed.
Attack — a quick swing at whoever is right in front of you (short reach). On hit: 2.8%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Fuse Flare — sets off a short blast ahead of him and over his head, lifting him a little; it launches hard, and he is open a while after it (short reach). On hit: 5.5%.
Floor Fizzle — fizzles a little blast along the floor at their feet (short reach). On hit: 4.3%.
Blast Ring — goes off in one big slow ring around him, once; it shoves everything near away (short reach). On hit: 5.3%.

Shrapnel Burst — blasts a burst of shrapnel a fair way ahead of him, which shoves him on a little; a slow heavy hit, hardest at the centre of the burst (medium reach). On hit: 9.6% at the centre (7.1% at the edge).

Fuse Pop — a quick pop right at his top as he blasts upward, rising fast (short reach). On hit: 4.3%.
Bomb Drop — drops like a bomb after a long fuse and blasts whoever is below down; he can jump out of it once it hits (medium reach). On hit: 9.4%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Fizz, 2.9%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Fizz — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2.9%.
Bomb Toss — lobs them ahead like a bomb. On hit: 8%.
Sorry! — blasts them off behind him, then says sorry. On hit: 8.5%.
Blast Up — blasts them skyward, ready for an up-air. On hit: 5.2%.
Fuse Stomp — stamps them into the floor. On hit: 5.6%.
Light My Fuse — you blow up, hitting everyone around you (short reach), hardest up close; it costs you 14%. On hit: 16.9%.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Short Fuse — hold C to let the fuse burn (you sink slowly), let go and the pop rocket-jumps you: the longer the fuse, the higher you go and the harder it rattles anyone beside you (short reach). It pops by itself when the fuse runs out. On hit: 2-3.8% for a quick pop, up to 8.5% for a full fuse, stuns.

Proximity Mine — sets a mine just ahead of you that arms after a moment and waits about 6 seconds; the first foe to step on it sets it off. Only one is out at a time: laying a new one removes the old. On hit: 28.2%.

Root & blast · Big Bang — roots you in place, then blasts everyone around you (short reach). On hit: 30%, sets them burning. Costs you 8%. Press V once: it charges for 0.5 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Fuse Sparkler — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): his fuse spits a thin jet with a ball of sparks at the top, like a lit sparkler: narrow all the way, straight up. On hit: 22.6%, burns them. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Stamp It Out! — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): a spark drops from his fuse and he stamps on it in a panic: three fast stamps at his own feet, front foot, back foot, then both, which kicks foes away low (it costs him nothing). On hit: 17.9%.

Stop, Drop and Roll — your fuse catches and you panic for half a second, then drop and roll 160 px forward along the floor to put it out; your rolling body hits each foe once and knocks them away low (short reach), and you end flat on your back, open for a moment. Costs you nothing. On hit: 9.4%, knocks them down.

Bubble Rise — blows a bubble up ahead of her (short reach). On hit: 4.2%.
Foam Skid — skids on a slick of foam into their feet (short reach). On hit: 3.3%.
Soap Spin — spins in a long cloud of suds that boops everything near her four times over (short reach). On hit: 2.4%.
Boop — boops forward with her whole round self (short reach). On hit: 4.8%.

Pop & Reform — pops, aim with the arrows (up if none), and reforms a short way that way, untouchable while gone, with a jump back; a soap drip falls from where she popped and leaves a slowing puddle. On hit: 3.3% from the drip, 2.2% from the puddle.
Bubble Shield — no hit: for 3 seconds you take 40% less damage and knockback.

Hop · Popped on Arrival — hops at the nearest foe (long reach) and stomps down on them. On hit: 13%, weakens their hits. Costs you 6%. Oh Noio! — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): she pops: a thin ring spreads out from her in three steps, weaker the further it gets, and throws foes straight away from her. On hit: 10.1%.
Bubble Raft Bump — blows a big bubble that swells for a moment, then drifts slowly ahead for 3 s, bouncing each foe it touches up and away. She can ride it; one hard hit pops it. On hit: 11%.

Drive — drives straight ahead off the tee (short reach). On hit: 8%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Slice — slices a heavy kick out behind her (short reach). On hit: 8.8%.
Lob Wedge — lobs straight up with a wedge (short reach). On hit: 4.8%.
Hole in One — drops like a ball into a cup and spikes whoever is below; she can jump out of it once it hits (short reach). On hit: 7.2%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Tap, 2.8%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Tap — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2.8%.
Tee Off — tees them up and sends them ahead. On hit: 7.6%.
Backspin — puts a backspin on them and sends them behind her. On hit: 8%.
Pop Fly — pops them up high, ready for an up-air. On hit: 5%.
Divot — drives them into the turf like a divot. On hit: 5.2%.
Zap Shooter — fires a fast bolt at the nearest foe in front of you, even up on a ledge (reaches the whole stage). On hit: 9%, stuns.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Water Hazard — you pop straight up, hang, then drop like a dead weight: in the air the drop hits whoever you fall onto and drives them DOWN, and lets go after a moment; the landing hits anyone beside you (short reach) and leaves a slowing puddle. On hit: 6% (the drop), 8% and a curse (the landing).
Announcer Crusher — no hit: a half-second brace; the next hit on you is stopped dead and its attacker is shoved away for 6%.

Presence — no hit at all: her presence, felt through walls -- every hit for five seconds curses Press V once: it charges for 0.5 s, then goes off by itself. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Lift-Off — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): launches her rocket: it climbs from the floor just ahead of her to far over her head, hitting whoever it meets on the way, and its exhaust is a weak hit on the floor where it stood. On hit: 9.2%. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Backspin — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): spins on the spot with backspin: whoever touches her is thrown BEHIND her, whichever side they stood on, and the turf she tears up sprays out ahead as a weak hit. On hit: 8.5%.
Sand Wedge Blast — a backswing, then a cone of bunker sand sprays ahead (medium reach). Sidestep it. On hit: 9%, they sink for 2 s (slowed, short jumps) and are cursed twice.

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Freeze Juice — Freezes a foe solid, hits them six times, then throws them.
Short hop, fast fall and wall jumps. CLINGS to a wall for about 0.6 s (her dimples catch) before she slides. Hole in One and Fairway Roll jump-cancel.
Attack — a quick swing at whoever is right in front of you (short reach). On hit: 2.8%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Barf Geyser — gathers himself a long beat, then barfs a geyser straight up; whoever it catches hangs up there a moment, ready for an up-air (medium reach). On hit: 5.8%, poisons.
Pebble Scatter — scatters pebbles round low along the floor in a wide arc, popping them up (medium reach). On hit: 4.6%, poisons.
Barf Column — barfs straight up and straight down at once, a tall column above and below him (medium reach). On hit: 6.4%, poisons.
Boulder Swing — swings himself forward like a boulder on a rope, a slow arc from above to ahead that carries him on (short reach). On hit: 8.8%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Barf Burst — barfs a big burst out behind him; his heaviest air hit, hardest at the centre of the burst, and he is open a while after it (medium reach). On hit: 11% at the centre (8.4% at the edge), poisons.
Pebble Spray — sprays pebbles in a wide arc up over him and down to ahead of him after a beat (medium reach). On hit: 5.6%.

Sit Down — gathers himself a long beat, then drops his whole wide weight flat onto whoever is below and squashes them out to the side and down; he can jump out of it once it hits (short reach). On hit: 10.8%, poisons.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Pebble Pound, 3.1%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Pebble Pound — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 3.1%.
Rock Toss — hefts them and tosses them ahead. On hit: 8.5%.
Boulder Hurl — spins and hurls them behind him. On hit: 9%.
Rock Lift — heaves them up on a ledge of rock, ready for an up-air. On hit: 5.5%.
Ground Pound — pounds them into the ground. On hit: 6%.
Barf — lobs a glob of barf (medium reach); if it misses it becomes a puddle that slows and poisons whoever steps in. On hit: 7%, poisons.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Red Balls — braces, then climbs slowly, armoured the whole way (hits do not stop it), steered a little with the arrows, as three red balls drop out and bounce away both ways (long reach). On hit: 3% per ball.
Poison Puddle — leaves a puddle at your feet for about 6 seconds; anyone standing in it keeps getting hit. On hit: 2%, poisons.

Root & blast · Toxic Wave — roots you in place, then blasts everyone around you (short reach) (in the air, you slam down first). On hit: 29%, poisons. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Down the Hatch — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): opens wide and gulps: whoever is over him is pulled down toward his mouth, a light hit, and then barfed straight back up. On hit: 22%, poisons them. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Stubbed Toe — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): just sits there, a rock: whoever is right up against him stubs a toe on him and hops away stunned (very short reach, all round him). On hit: 20%, stuns them.

Barf Jet Rocket — barfs downward and jets up for up to 2 s, steering with the arrows (a new press ends it); the stream poisons anyone below. A hit knocks you out of it. On hit: 2% a splash (up to 4), poisons.

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Infinite Matter Overload — A generator in his mouth pours stuff on a foe, then overloads and blows.
Short hop, fast fall and wall jumps. CLINGS to a wall for about 1 s before he slides. Rockfall and Rock Skid jump-cancel; Rock Skid keeps its speed.
Attack — a quick punch right in front of you (short reach). On hit: 3%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Page Turn — turns a big page up and over in a wide arc ahead of her (medium reach). On hit: 4.6%.
Bookmark — jabs her bookmark along the floor at their feet (short reach). On hit: 3.5%.
Flip Through — flips through her pages in a whirl, slapping everything near her four times over (short reach). On hit: 2.7%.
Hardcover — swings her hard cover forward like a club (short reach). On hit: 7.4%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Spine Back — bangs her spine into whoever is behind her (short reach). On hit: 8.4%.
Page Fan — fans her pages up and forward in a cone (medium reach). On hit: 4.9%.
Book Drop — drops flat like a dropped book and spikes whoever is below (short reach). On hit: 7.9%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Paper Cut, 2.3%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Paper Cut — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2.3%.
Slam Shut — slams herself shut on them and shoves them ahead. On hit: 7%.
Flip Back — flips them back over her cover, behind her. On hit: 7.5%.
Book Report — reports them up high, ready for an up-air. On hit: 5%.
Press Flat — presses them flat between her pages. On hit: 4.8%.
Define — no hit: marks whoever last hit you (or a random foe) for 10 seconds; your hits on them do 15% more, stacking up to 5 times.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Gravity Page — hops up swinging (short reach); keep holding C and she writes gravity weaker, floating up slowly and steadily for a while, steered freely; let go to stop. A jump back when it ends; a hit ends it. On hit: 3%, or 6% right up close, knocks them down.
Brace — no hit: braces for under half a second, taking less damage and much less knockback.

Lunge · Hardcover Slam — lunges forward (medium reach) and hits the first foe it touches. On hit: 23%, marks them to take more. Breaks shields. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Slam Shut — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): opens wide, her covers out flat to both sides at head height, a light hit that pulls foes in over her, then claps shut: the closed book standing tall over her head launches. On hit: 19.5%. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Footnote — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): stamps, and a footnote star pops up at the foot of the page on each side of her: a small sharp hit on the floor a step away, and nothing right against her or above the knee. On hit: 17.5%.
Pop-Up Page — flips open, and a cardboard castle folds up out of the floor ahead, then springs, flinging anyone still standing there skyward; it stands 5 s as a platform. On hit: 9%, launches up.

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Overdue — A giant page turns up and over, scooping foes and flinging them behind her.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. No cling and no cancel: Page Glide is her way in.
Attack — a jab just in front of you (short reach). On hit: 3%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Fry Fountain — squeezes the carton and a fountain of fries shoots straight up, tall and thin, far over his head (medium reach). On hit: 4.5%.
Fry Sweep — sweeps a fistful of fries round low along the floor, a wide arc that skids them away flat (medium reach). On hit: 3.5%.
Fry Scatter — fries shoot out of him at once in a slanting line, from behind his shoulder to ahead of his feet, twice over (short reach). On hit: 2.3%.
Fry Skewer — thrusts one long thin fry straight out ahead, a poke from well out of their reach; the far tip of the fry hits harder (medium reach). On hit: 6.5% at the tip (4.9% closer in).

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Grease Spit — spits a gob of hot grease a long way out behind him; his heaviest air hit, and he is open a while after it (medium reach). On hit: 7.5%.
Fry Toss — tosses a fry up and ahead of him; it bumps whoever it meets forward and up (medium reach). On hit: 4.2%.
Fry Rain — drops a flat line of fries straight down under him after a beat; it shoves whoever is below out to the side and down (short reach). On hit: 6%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Salt Shake, 2.2%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Salt Shake — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2.2%.
Take Out — bags them up and tosses them ahead. On hit: 6.8%.
Dip — dips them and flings them behind him. On hit: 7.3%.
Super Size — heaves them up high, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.8%.
Squashed Fry — squashes them flat like a dropped fry. On hit: 4.6%.
Fry Dart — throws three fries straight ahead (very long reach). On hit: 4% a fry, sometimes two land.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Fry Flick — you hop and flick one fry up and forward (very long reach); keep holding C and time slows around you: you hang at that height and drift for a while, and whoever touches you is slowed. Let go to drop. On hit: 4% (the fry), 2% (a touch), slows them.
Fry Trap — sets a trap just ahead of you that stays about 5 seconds; foes standing on it keep getting hit. On hit: 8%.

Shockwave · Deep Fryer — a shockwave bursts out around you (medium reach) after a short wind-up. On hit: 18%, sets them burning. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Out With the Old — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): tosses his stale fries out over his shoulder: three thin fries fan from straight overhead to up and BEHIND him, and throw foes up and back (nothing in front of him). On hit: 15%. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Hands Off My Fries! — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): guards his carton: a hard smack straight down on whoever is reaching in from the front, close in, from his shoulder to the floor, then, a beat later, the same behind him (short reach). On hit: 14%.

Carton Over Their Head — lobs your carton in an arc at the nearest foe ahead (hold back to lob it at the nearest one behind); whoever it lands on is capped inside for 0.8 s, then it bursts off in hot fries. Dodge the arc. On hit: 9%.

Limit — taking 100% damage fills your Limit (it stays when you lose a stock). Then your neutral special, down special and neutral smash each get one powered use, in any order; all three are stronger. C: Supersize (seven fries and one giant fry). ↓ + C: Hot Oil Spill (three traps that burn). V: Deep Fryer (a bigger ring, then fries fly out all round).

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Get Digging — Makes a foe dig a pit with a shovel, then the pit crumbles in.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. No cling and no cancel: Salt Slide is his way in.
Attack — three quick syringe jabs just in front of him (short reach); the third one launches. On hit: 3 hits of 3%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Fork Flip — flips a steak fork up and ahead, over whoever is in front (medium reach). On hit: 4.1%, leaves them bleeding.
Ankle Jab — stabs his syringe low at their ankles (short reach). On hit: 3.1%.
Wobble Spin — wobbles round in a whirl, slapping everything near him three times over (short reach). On hit: 2.7%.
Syringe Stab — stabs his syringe forward, then jiggles back (short reach). On hit: 5.4%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Jelly Back — wobbles his whole body back into whoever is behind him (short reach). On hit: 6.9%.
Fork Up — jabs his fork straight up and ahead (short reach). On hit: 4%.
Syringe Drop — drops syringe-first onto whoever is below (short reach). On hit: 6.5%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Poke, 1.9%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Poke — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 1.9%.
Jelly Toss — wobbles them up and tosses them ahead. On hit: 6.2%.
Shake Off — shakes them off behind him. On hit: 6.6%.
Syringe Lift — lifts them up on his syringe, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.4%.
Set Down — sets them down in a quivering heap. On hit: 4.2%.
Freeze Syringe — throws a syringe in a low arc (medium reach). On hit: 6%, freezes them once they are above 40%.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Spikeball Headphones — the headphones Yellow Face gave him: he floats up while C is held (steer with the arrows), and they shoot a spikeball out to each side, one left and one right (medium reach). On hit: 5% each, leaves them bleeding.

Steak Sizzle — slaps a sizzling steak from his steakhouse onto the floor just ahead: a hot plate for 2.5 seconds. A foe who stands on it is seared and keeps burning while they stay. Jump over it. On hit: 3%, sets them burning.

Trap · Ice Breaker — sets a trap just ahead of you; the first foe to step on it takes the hit. On hit: 18%, freezes them once they are above 40%. Breaks shields. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Order Up! — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): flips a steak off the grill of his steakhouse: it goes up in a curve from waist high in front of him to far over his head, hitting harder the higher it gets. On hit: 15%. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Bounce House — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): flattens into a wide wobbling slab of jelly on the floor and springs back: whoever is on it or beside it is bounced STRAIGHT UP, not out to the side. On hit: 14%.

Daily Specials — each use throws the next of three, hit or miss: Jelly Legs (a jelly glob in an arc; they slide as if on ice for 3 s, 7%), Sleepy Serum (a fast syringe dart straight ahead; slows them, 5%), Hot Skillet (a red-hot pan in an arc; launches and burns, 8%). The ring at his feet and the icon by his name show which is next.

Limit — taking 100% damage fills your Limit (it stays when you lose a stock). Then your neutral special, down special and neutral smash each get one powered use, in any order; all three are stronger. C: Deep Freeze (three shots that freeze at any damage). ↓ + C: Mixed Grill (a bigger hot plate that sears harder and lasts longer). V: Glacier Breaker (a bigger mine that lasts longer, and a freezing spray).

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Jelly Quake — Bounces a foe on a jelly dome in his steakhouse, higher each time.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. No cling and no cancel: Slip Slide is his way in.
Attack — a quick hit right in front of you (short reach). On hit: 2.5%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Flip Up — flips himself up and forward over whoever is in front (short reach). On hit: 4.5%.
Edge Roll — rolls low on his edge into their feet (medium reach). On hit: 3.3%.
Coin Spin — spins on his edge like a coin on a table, clipping everything near him four times over (short reach). On hit: 2.8%.
Heads Up — flips forward heads-up and lands on whoever is ahead (short reach). On hit: 6.3%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Tails Back — flips tails-up behind him (short reach). On hit: 7.4%.
Toss Up — tosses himself straight up and catches whoever is above (short reach). On hit: 4.1%.
Cash Drop — drops like a dropped coin and spikes whoever is below (short reach). On hit: 6.7%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Rattle, 2%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Rattle — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2%.
Heads or Tails — flips them ahead of him, heads or tails. On hit: 6.6%.
Double or Nothing — flips them behind him for double or nothing. On hit: 7%.
Loose Change — spins them up like loose change, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.6%.
Pressed Penny — presses them flat like a penny on the rails. On hit: 4.4%.
Heads or Tails — flips a coin: heads (7 in 10) throws a bouncing coin (very long reach) and gives you armour; tails hops you back and costs you 3%. On hit: 12%.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Money Explosion — you bounce like a flipped coin: press C again in the air for up to two more hops, each a little lower, steered with the arrows, and a coin drops and bounces out from under you on every hop (long reach). On hit: 4% a coin.
Gamble Defense — no hit: a coin toss; lucky gives you armour for most of a second, unlucky costs you 6%.

Hop · Coin Flop — hops at the nearest foe (long reach) and stomps down on them. On hit: 17%, knocks them down, launches far. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

No Arms Needed — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): has no arms, so he tips back on his rim and kicks: left foot, right foot, two light kicks straight up that hold the foe there, then both feet together; the soles at the very top launch hard, the legs under them only a little. On hit: 15% with all three kicks and the soles. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Can't Touch — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): he and Coiny can never touch, and for a quarter of a second neither can anyone else: a field stands a step away on each side of him, from head height to the floor, and whoever walks or falls into it while it is up is thrown straight away from him (nothing right against him and nothing overhead). On hit: 11%.
Double or Nothing Bounce — hops onto the nearest foe's head within 200 px; press on each landing to bounce again for double. Miss the beat and you fall flat. On hit: 3%, then 6%, then 12% (launches).

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Static Storm — Floats up on balloons into a storm and zaps a foe with lightning.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. No cling and no cancel: Rolling Stone is his way in.

Attack — puffs a little cloud straight ahead (reaches the whole stage) that stings three times; ← or → aims it, on the ground and in the air alike. A foe touching her front (within about 15 px of her) is bopped instead, 8% in the air. On hit: 3 hits of 2%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Pop-Up — a rising pop over her head that tosses them straight up, ready for an up-air (short reach). On hit: 4%.
Roll Under — scoots forward low and rolls under their feet, popping them up (short reach). On hit: 3.5%.
Spit — the same as X on the ground, in the air too, and with ← or → as well: it puffs the way the arrow points, as on the ground and in flight. Her air moves are ↑ + X and ↓ + X.
Sky Pop — pops straight up, juggling whoever is above (short reach). On hit: 4%.
Belly Drop — hovers a beat, then drops belly-first and spikes whoever is under her (short reach). On hit: 6.5%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Nibble, 1.9%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Nibble — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 1.9%.
Rainbow Spit — spits them out in a rainbow. On hit: 6.5%.
Rollercoaster — whirls them round and flings them behind her. On hit: 7%.
Up She Goes — bounces them skyward, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.5%.
Pounce — flattens them on the floor and rolls off, leaving them down. On hit: 4%.
Flight — no hit: you fly freely for 1.5 seconds, and your next X hits much harder.
The neutral special, aimed that way.
Float Boost — no hit: you hop upward, get a jump back, and fly freely for about a second.
Hover — no hit: you float where you are, flying freely for 1.5 seconds.

Meteor Puff — dives down and body-slams whoever she lands on; a dive from real height pays out Momentum Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

All Aboard — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): flies a short way straight up and takes whoever is over her along for the ride, as she carries her team: two light lifts on her back, then she bucks them off at the top (she ends up in the air and comes back down). On hit: 15%. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Rainbow Whirl — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): spins flat on the spot and whirls foes round her: a foe in front is thrown up and over to behind her, a foe behind up and over to the front. On hit: 13.8%.

Grow — a quick breath, then she swells to one and a half times her size, bumping away every foe she touches as she grows; for 6 s she stays big, her hits doing 30% more damage and 20% more knockback, then she shrinks back and can grow again 12 s later. On hit: 9%.

Reflector — hold Z: a pane in front of you turns enemy shots back at their owner, 1.8x faster and 1.3x the damage (at most 12%). It takes 7 frames from the press to come up, lasts up to 36 while Z is held, and leaves you open for 22 frames after (then 30 more before you can raise it again). It does nothing against melee or grabs. The strong fighters have this instead of a shield. Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Vocoder Trance — Sings a song that entrances nearby foes, then sends a rainbow wave of barf.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. No cling: she flies.
Gem Bolt — fires a gem that bounces along the floor (very long reach); hold up or down right after to bend its arc. On hit: 4%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Gem Rise — rises up on her gem edge ahead of her and over her head (medium reach). On hit: 5.3%.
Low Facet — cuts a low facet along the floor at their feet (short reach). On hit: 4.1%.

Gem Bolt — the same as X on the ground (fires a gem that bounces), in the air too: her aerials are X with a direction. No neutral air: the bolt is her identity ("Keep the spit", for Puffball, was the same call).

Cut and Cast — cuts them loose and casts them behind her. On hit: 7.8%.

Set in Stone — sets them in the floor like a stone. On hit: 5%.
Refraction Beam — no hit: charges your next Gem Bolt into a bouncing beam that goes through foes for 11%.

Gem-Hard — she braces, then climbs straight up slowly, armoured the whole way (hits do not stop her), steered a little with the arrows, and swings at the top (short reach). On hit: 10% at the edge of the swing, 5% up close.
Shard Spray — throws three gem shards in a fan that bounce along the floor (medium reach). On hit: 4% each.

Beam · Prism Burst — fires an instant beam straight ahead (reaches the whole stage). On hit: 20%, sets them burning. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Glint — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): catches the light: a four-point sparkle flashes over her head, a tall thin line and a short flat one that cross, and the middle where they cross hits hardest. On hit: 20%. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Dispersion — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): light splits through her: three thin rays fan out low on each side, along the floor, knee high and chest high at their ends. On hit: 18%.

Refracting Prism — sets a crystal prism ahead; its spikes push out of it one at a time (forward, up, then back), each growing for a moment first; then it stays 4 s splitting your Gem Bolts in three. On hit: 10%, pops them up.

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Refraction — Three gem bolts, low, middle and high, pierce foes and bounce around.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. Gem Drop can be jump-cancelled once it hits. No cling.
Attack — a jab just in front of you (short reach). On hit: 3.5%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Price Hike — hikes a price tag up and over in an arc ahead of him (short reach). On hit: 4.6%.
Clearance Kick — kicks the clearance bin along the floor at their feet (short reach). On hit: 3.8%.
Sale Spin — spins his sign round him in a sale, hitting everything near him four times over (short reach). On hit: 2.8%.
Loud Shout — shouts straight ahead in a short, loud blast that stuns them for a moment (short reach). On hit: 7.3%, stuns them briefly.

BUY NOW! — a loud soundwave blasts the space in front of you (short reach). On hit: 7%, stuns.

On hit: 21% on a foe at 50% or more, 14% on anyone else. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Side Effects May Include — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): reads the small print very fast: a round hit at chest height on each side of him, and the side effect depends on the side; in front it leaves them dizzy (their arrows swapped), behind him drowsy (slowed). On hit: 16%, dizzy in front, slowed behind.

C: Limited Time Offer! (a bigger cone, a longer stun, and it weakens). ↓ + C: Everybody Gets One! (weakens every foe near him and stuns them). V: Buy One, Get Two Free! (three pops: two hold, the last launches).

Actually... — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): smarter than they said: she raises a finger and corrects whoever is in front of her, a short hit from her waist up to their chin; a foe caught in the middle of an attack of their own is put right properly, anyone else gets less (nothing behind her). On hit: 14.5% on a foe who is attacking, 10% on anyone else.

Somebody Refill Me! — after a half-second gulp she drains every poisoned foe around her (long reach): the poison they still had lands all at once, and she heals half of it (up to 10%). Nothing poisoned, nothing gained. On hit: the rest of their poison.

Pom Punch — punches forward with a pom-pom of ribbons (short reach). On hit: 6.1%.

Gale Push — pushes a wide gale ahead of her and a little down (medium reach). On hit: 5.4%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Slam Behind — slams her gate shut behind her (short reach). On hit: 8.9%.
Gate Up — throws her gate up and ahead like a drawbridge (medium reach). On hit: 5%.
Slam Shut — drops with her gate swinging shut and spikes whoever is below (short reach). On hit: 8.1%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Rattle, 2.5%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Rattle — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2.5%.
Shut In — swings shut on them and shoves them ahead. On hit: 7.1%.
Swing Back — swings them open behind her. On hit: 7.6%.
Drawbridge — raises them like a drawbridge, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.9%.
Latched Down — latches them to the floor. On hit: 4.7%.
Swing Open — bounces enemy shots back for about half a second, and after a short wind-up a ring bursts around her (short reach). On hit: 5%.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Slam Shut — jumps up with armour and hangs, then the gate slams shut on anyone just under and in front of her, driving them DOWN; then she drops (in the air the drop lets go after a moment), and the landing hits foes right beside her (short reach) and leaves a brief patch that roots. On hit: 8% (the slam), 9% (the landing); the patch does 4% and roots them for a second.
Reflect Stance — no hit: for about three-quarters of a second, enemy shots that touch her bounce back at whoever threw them.

Pull · Gate Swing — pulls nearby foes in (medium reach), then hits. On hit: 20%, strips armour and stances, launches far. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Return to Sender — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): shuts over her head, her top rail flat above her: whoever comes down or in on it is sent back the way they came, at the same strength whatever the direction (always upward, at 45 degrees or steeper); a foe who was not moving goes straight up. On hit: 17%, back the way they came. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Come On In — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): the welcoming one: she swings open and whoever is in front of her is waved through to her other side, a light hit; then she shuts on them there and sends them on their way, behind her; a foe who was already behind her gets only the shutting. On hit: 16% with both, 11% from the shutting alone.
Gate Swings Round — plants a gatepost just ahead; post and gate come up out of the floor, then the gate swings round in a wide arc (medium reach), waist high. Jump it, or stand back. On hit: 11%.

Limit — taking 100% damage fills your Limit (it stays when you lose a stock). Then your neutral special, down special and neutral smash each get one powered use, in any order; all three are stronger. C: Gate Crash (a longer reflect and a bigger swing that strips armour). ↓ + C: Iron Gate (twice as long, braced, and the gate slams round her). V: Judgement Gate (pulls from farther, then slams shut both ways).

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Swing Open — Flings a foe back and forth between her and Two, five times.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. No cling and no cancel.
Attack — three quick swipes right in front of you (short reach). On hit: 3 hits of 1.8%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Grass Spring — springs up and forward in a swirl of grass over whoever is in front (short reach). On hit: 3.4%.
Trip Blade — trips them with a low blade of grass (short reach). On hit: 2.7%.
Lawn Spin — spins like a lawn sprinkler, clipping everything near her three times over (short reach). On hit: 2.3%.
Mow Down — mows forward in the air (short reach). On hit: 4.6%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Weed Whip — whips a weed out behind her; the tip of the weed hits harder (short reach). On hit: 7.3% at the tip (5.5% closer in).
Sprout Up — sprouts straight up and ahead (short reach). On hit: 3.3%.
Roots Down — drops with her roots out and spikes whoever is below (short reach). On hit: 5.4%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Tickle, 1.7%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Tickle — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 1.7%.
Hay Toss — bundles them in grass and tosses them ahead. On hit: 5.2%.
Mown Down — mows them off behind her. On hit: 5.6%.
Tall Grass — grows them up high in tall grass, ready for an up-air. On hit: 3.7%.
Planted — plants them in the lawn. On hit: 3.5%.
Grasstree — no hit: you climb a tree for 4 seconds: armour, and your X hits harder and reaches further, but you walk slower.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Spring Back — a moment of standing firm: get stepped on (hit) in it and the hit does nothing, you spring back up extra high and trip them; if nothing comes, you spring up in a swirl of grass that trips anyone beside you (short reach). A hit that lands heals you 3%. On hit: 6.3% (the spring back) or 3.6%, knocks them down.
Take Root — you root yourself with armour for under half a second, and a bramble springs up beside you that hurts anyone who steps on it. On hit: 2.7% over and over.

Roller · Overgrowth — sends it along the ground (very long reach), hitting everyone in its path. On hit: 18%, roots them in place. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Greener on the Other Side — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): the grass is greener on the other side, so she grows it on both: two tall blades shoot up out of the floor a step to each side of her, and whoever they catch is thrown up; nothing straight over her head is hit. On hit: 14.4%. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Itchy — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): her blades sprout along the floor on both sides, and grass is itchy: whoever they reach is nudged away and scratches, with their arrows mixed up for three-quarters of a second. On hit: 10.8%, and scrambles them.

Step On Me, Go Flying — lies flat as a patch of grass for up to 2.5 s (armour, can't move). The first foe who steps on it is sprung skyward. Jump over it, or hit the patch to end it. On hit: 9%, launches up.

Limit — taking 100% damage fills your Limit (it stays when you lose a stock). Then your neutral special, down special and neutral smash each get one powered use, in any order; all three are stronger. C: Full Bloom (a longer Grasstree, and roots burst up round him). ↓ + C: Deep Roots (more armour, three rooting brambles, heals a little). V: Rolling Forest (a bigger roller, and a second rolls back).

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Nobody Steps on Me — Blades of grass shoot up out of the floor both ways from under her.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. No cling and no cancel.
Attack — a quick swing at whoever is right in front of you (short reach). On hit: 2.3%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Lightning Rod — raises a rod of lightning up and over in an arc ahead of her (medium reach). On hit: 4.2%, stuns them briefly.
Ground Arc — arcs a bolt along the floor at their feet (short reach). On hit: 3.3%.
Static Ring — crackles in a ring of static that zaps everything near her four times over (short reach). On hit: 2.6%.
Bolt Straight — fires a short, straight bolt ahead of her; the tip of the bolt hits harder (medium reach). On hit: 7.1% at the tip (5.4% closer in).

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Rear Zap — zaps out behind her (short reach). On hit: 7.1%.
Sky Bolt — throws a bolt up and forward (medium reach). On hit: 4.4%.
Thunder Drop — drops like a thunderbolt and spikes whoever is below (short reach). On hit: 6.7%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Shock, 1.9%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Shock — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 1.9%.
Chain Throw — zaps them along a chain and lets go ahead. On hit: 6.2%.
Crossed Wires — crosses their wires and sends them behind her. On hit: 6.6%.
Jolt Up — jolts them skyward, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.2%.
Grounded — grounds them with a crackle. On hit: 4%.
Chain Bolt — lightning instantly zaps the nearest foe (long reach), then arcs on to up to two more foes near them. On hit: 8%.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Flash — you crackle for a moment while you aim with the arrows (up if none), then zip a long way that way as a bolt, burning whoever you pass, and run fast for a second; a burning bolt strikes down where you stood. After the zip you fall helpless (no jump or attack) until you land. On hit: 6%, sets them burning.
Floor Trap — sets a small trap just ahead of you for about 4 seconds; anyone who steps on it gets zapped. On hit: 11%.

Dash · Arc Cascade — dashes forward (long reach); anyone you run into takes the hit. On hit: 20%, stuns, launches far. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Rising Rush — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): a wide swing over your head that launches foes straight up. On hit: 18%, launches up. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.
Low Rush — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): a low sweep that hits both sides at once and sends foes low and out. On hit: 16%.

Pocket Thundercloud — a small thundercloud drifts after the nearest foe for 4 s; each second it darkens and sparks, then a bolt strikes straight down from it. Get out from under it. On hit: 7% a bolt (up to 4).

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
The Storm of Goiky — Impales a foe with a bolt, then three strikes bring landmarks down on them.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. No cling and no cancel.
Attack — a long-reaching jab in front of you (medium reach). On hit: 3%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Switch Up — flips her switch up and over in an arc ahead of her (medium reach). On hit: 4.3%.
Toe Flip — flips a toe along the floor at their feet (short reach). On hit: 3.4%.
Lights Out Spin — spins her arm round her, flicking everything near her four times over (short reach). On hit: 3%.
Switch Hit — hits forward with the flat of her switch (medium reach). On hit: 5.9%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Back Flip — flips her switch back at whoever is behind her (short reach). On hit: 7.3%.
Lights On — flashes the lights on above and ahead of her (medium reach). On hit: 4.7%.
Flip Down — flips down onto whoever is below and spikes them (short reach). On hit: 6.9%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Flick, 2.2%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Flick — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2.2%.
Hurl — hurls them ahead along her long arm. On hit: 7%.
Switch Sides — switches sides with them and hurls them behind her. On hit: 7.4%.
Light Up — lights them up and flips them skyward, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.8%.
Switched Off — switches them off flat on the floor. On hit: 4.6%.
Flip Switch — dashes forward, untouchable (long reach), grabbing a foe right in front and pulling them in to Hurl; anyone farther along takes 12%. On hit: 6%, roots them in place.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Switch On — the light flashes, stunning everyone right beside you (short reach), and you shoot off like light, very fast and far: straight up, or toward the side you hold; no steering once you go. Whoever your front hits is stunned too. After it you fall helpless (no jump or attack) until you land. On hit: 7% (less off the front), stuns.
Hurl — throws the foe your Flip Switch grabbed. With nobody held it flips your lights: on gives armour and a stronger next Attack. On hit: 13%, launches far.

Dash · Floodlight — dashes forward (medium reach); anyone you run into takes the hit. On hit: 24%, scrambles their controls. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Rising Rush — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): a wide swing over your head that launches foes straight up. On hit: 21%, launches up. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.
Low Rush — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): a low sweep that hits both sides at once and sends foes low and out. On hit: 20%.

Flick On, Flick Off — clicks ON with an uppercut in front of you (short reach); if it lands, press again to click OFF, springing after them to spike them down. Whiffing leaves you open. On hit: 8% (pops up), then 9% (spikes down).
