It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Lights Out — Flips her secret switch and drives a foe through two boats.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. DASH TECH (Celeste's) is Capture the Flag only: there, jumping out of a dash is a hyper or a super.
Attack — a jab just in front of you (short reach). On hit: 3.3%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Sugar Pop — pops her candy high over her head after a beat; it scrambles whoever it meets up there (medium reach). On hit: 4.3%, scrambles their controls.
Sticky Sweep — sweeps the sticky candy round low at their feet, quick, and glues them there a moment as it bumps them off (medium reach). On hit: 3.8%, roots them briefly.
Sugar Swirl — swirls her candy round her in a wide slow circle, once; it slings whoever it catches away flat (short reach). On hit: 5%.
Candy Hook — hooks her candy round in a wide arc from above to ahead of her and sends them skidding level (medium reach). On hit: 6.4%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Stick Swing — swings her stick up and back behind her in a rising arc, lifting whoever is there up and away; her heaviest air hit (short reach). On hit: 8.2%.
Sweet Spot — pops her candy up close above her, hardest at the very top of the sweet end (short reach). On hit: 5.6% at the candy (4% elsewhere).
Candy Bounce — drops candy-end first a little ahead of her and bounces whoever is below forward and down, stuck to the floor (short reach). On hit: 7%, roots them.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Lick, 2.5%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Lick — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2.5%.
Sticky Toss — tosses them ahead, covered in candy. On hit: 7.2%.
Stick Swing — swings them round on her stick and lets go behind her. On hit: 7.6%.
Sucker Punch Up — pops them up on her candy, ready for an up-air. On hit: 5%.
Stuck to the Floor — sticks them to the floor like candy. On hit: 4.8%.
Sticky Sucker — fires a sticky candy straight ahead (very long reach); your smash sends a foe it rooted flying farther. On hit: 5%, roots them in place.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Candy Twirl — you rise in a dizzy twirl: whoever you rise into is carried up with you (small hits), then spat out at the top with their controls scrambled. On hit: small hits on the way up, then 5%, scrambles their controls.
Rooting Trap — sets a sticky trap just ahead of you; the first foe to step on it takes the hit. On hit: 6%, roots them in place.

Trap · Fork Repellent — holds out a spray can and sprays a short cone in front of her (110 px long, 70 px across at the end): everyone in it is pushed straight away from her, with no status. On hit: 18%. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Stuck-Up — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): turns her nose up: her candy end snaps up and back over her shoulder; the candy is the real hit, the stick under it is a weak one. On hit: 18% on the candy, 10% on the stick. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Sugar Crash — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): the crash after the sugar rush: she drops candy-first onto the floor in front of her, and whoever it lands on crashes too, slow and heavy for a second and a half (nothing behind her). On hit: 15%, and slows them.

Sugar Rush Flurry — a quick lick, then you lunge along the floor (long reach) in a flurry of five candy swings, carrying whoever they catch; the last one launches. Hold back during the lick to lunge the other way. Then you crash and are slowed for a second. In the air (once a jump) the first swing must catch a foe, or that is all; then you fall as you lunge. Jump it, or stand clear of the path. On hit: 5 hits of 3% (the last launches).

Reflector — hold Z: a pane in front of you turns enemy shots back at their owner, 1.8x faster and 1.3x the damage (at most 12%). It takes 7 frames from the press to come up, lasts up to 36 while Z is held, and leaves you open for 22 frames after (then 30 more before you can raise it again). It does nothing against melee or grabs. The strong fighters have this instead of a shield. Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Sticky Trap — A sticky patch opens ahead, drags nearby foes in, then snaps shut.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. No cling and no cancel: Sticky Skate is her way in.
Attack — a quick hit just in front of him (short reach). On hit: 2.5%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Chill Rise — rises with a chill up and over in an arc ahead of him (medium reach). On hit: 5.2%.
Ice Skid — skids low along the floor on a streak of ice (short reach). On hit: 3.9%.
Cold Spin — spins cool, his cold shoulders clipping everything near him four times over (short reach). On hit: 3%.
Too Cool Punch — punches forward, too cool to miss (short reach). On hit: 7.3%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Cold Shoulder — gives whoever is behind him the cold shoulder (short reach). On hit: 8.4%.
Cool Uppercut — uppercuts up and ahead of him, coolly (medium reach). On hit: 5.3%.
Cold Drop — drops cold onto whoever is below and spikes them (short reach). On hit: 7.5%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Chill Poke, 2.3%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Chill Poke — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2.3%.
Frozen Toss — freezes them stiff and tosses them ahead. On hit: 6.9%.
Too Cool — is too cool to turn round, and flings them behind him. On hit: 7.3%.
Ice Lift — lifts them on an iceberg, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.7%.
Cooled Off — cools them off flat on the floor. On hit: 4.5%.
Stay Cool — a moment of armour, and his next Attack (X) hits much harder: 16% instead of 6%. When the armour runs out a cold blast pops foes right beside him up (short reach). On hit: 3%.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Too Cool to Touch — a moment of standing cool: get hit in it and the hit does nothing, you rise extra high and knock them away; if nothing comes, you hop up with an uppercut (short reach), hardest right up close. On hit: 9% (the counter), or 5% (9% up close).
Shrug It Off — no hit: clears every status on you (burn, bleed, slow, weaken, ice), heals you 6% and gives short armour.

Shockwave · Fifty Spins — whirls a swing seat on its chains over the bar in front of him, an upright circle about 55 px across, twice: the second turn throws them and leaves them dizzy, their arrows swapped for a moment (nothing behind him). On hit: 19.5%, the second turn leaves them dizzy (arrows swapped). Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

High Five — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): everybody wants one: holds a hand up high, a little ahead of him, and whoever meets it drops their guard: any armour or reflect stance they had up is gone (a counter still counters him). On hit: 16.5%, and ends their armour or reflect stance. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Made You Look — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): one small lie: he points up, a light hit over his head that catches anyone jumping in, and while they look he takes their feet out from under them with a low hit in front that sends them out flat along the floor (nothing behind him). On hit: 16% with both (3% from the point, 13% from the low hit).

Effortless Catch — stands ready for a second, barely trying. The first hit or shot that would land on him he catches, taking nothing, and throws it straight back as a fast ball (very long reach). Wait it out, or grab him. On hit: 10%.

It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). The Tiny Loser Chamber — Packs foes into a chamber and bashes its side, then caves it in.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. No cling and no cancel.
Attack — a quick hit right in front of you (short reach). On hit: 2.8%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Upward Stroke — strokes up and over in an arc ahead of him (medium reach). On hit: 4.4%.
Ink Blot — blots ink along the floor at their feet and slows them (short reach). On hit: 3.4%, slows them.
Doodle Spin — spins doodling, flicking ink round him four times over (short reach). On hit: 2.9%.
Long Stroke — draws a long stroke straight ahead, hardest at the tip (medium reach). On hit: 6.4% at the tip (4.4% elsewhere).

rows.text: Back Stroke — strokes a line out behind him (short reach). On hit: 7.2%.
Scribble Up — scribbles straight up and forward (medium reach). On hit: 4.5%.
Tip Drop — drops tip-first and spikes whoever is below, slowing them (short reach). On hit: 6.6%, slows them.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Underline, 2.2%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Underline — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2.2%.
Sign Here — signs them off ahead of him. On hit: 6.8%.
Crossed Out — crosses them out behind him. On hit: 7.2%.
Highlight — highlights them up high, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.6%.
Full Stop — puts a full stop on them, flat on the floor. On hit: 4.4%.
Ink Spray — sprays a short cone of ink in front of you (short reach). On hit: 9%, slows them, weakens their hits.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Upward Scribble — he scribbles a line of ink to the nearest ledge in reach and climbs it; anyone on the line is hit, pulled in and iced over. Nothing in reach to draw to: only a short hop. On hit: 5%, ices them over.
Slowing Puddle — spills an ink puddle just ahead that lasts about 5 seconds; foes standing in it keep getting hit. On hit: 5%, slows them.

Roller · Permanent Marker — sends it along the ground (very long reach) until it hits someone. On hit: 20%, weakens their hits. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Pop the Cap — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): he pops his cap off and it rises straight up, bumping whoever it hits up with it (3% three times) and popping them off the top, about 125 px up (6%). On hit: 15% with all four (3% + 3% + 3% + 6%). A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Mark My Words — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): he underlines his point along the floor in front of him, a long line out to about 160 px; whoever it underlines is sent out low and marked for 3 s (his next hits on them land harder). On hit: 13%, and marks them.

Trace Their Outline — traces a dotted outline round the nearest foe (long reach) where they stand. It fills with ink for 1.5 s; still inside when it is full, they are inked in. Step out of it. On hit: no damage; rooted 0.6 s, then slowed 2 s.

Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Permanent Record — Four volleys of ink drops spray across a wide cone in front of him.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. No cling and no cancel.
Attack — a quick swing at whoever is right in front of you (short reach). On hit: 2.8%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.

Paper Cut — whips a bill up and over in an arc ahead of her, leaving a paper cut; the far edge of the bill hits harder (medium reach). On hit: 5.6% with the edge of the bill (4.2% closer in), leaves them bleeding.
Coin Flick — flicks a coin along the floor at their feet (short reach). On hit: 3.5%.
Bill Fan — spins with a fan of bills, clipping everything near her four times over (short reach). On hit: 2.6%.

rows.text: Rear Panel — bangs his rear panel into whoever is behind him (short reach). On hit: 9.9%.
Channel Up — changes the channel up through whoever is above him (medium reach). On hit: 6.1%.
Power Cut — drops like a plug pulled and spikes whoever is below; he can jump out of it once it hits (medium reach). On hit: 11.6%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Buzz, 3.1%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Buzz — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 3.1%.
Rerun — shows them a rerun and shoves them ahead. On hit: 8.5%.
Off Switch — switches them off and sends them behind him. On hit: 9%.
Volume Up — turns the volume up and blasts them overhead, ready for an up-air. On hit: 5.6%.
Static Press — presses them flat against his screen and fizzles. On hit: 6%.
Scan Lines — two bars of static sweep out ahead, one at head height and one at your feet (long reach). On hit: 5% each.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Power Saving — you switch off (gone and untouchable a moment) while you aim with the arrows (up if none), then blink back on a long way that way; foes where you reappear get hit. After it you fall helpless (no jump or attack) until you land. On hit: 3%, scrambles their controls.
Pause — after a short wind-up, hits pause on the nearest foe (medium reach) and holds them in place. On hit: no damage, roots them.

Beam · Dead Air — fires an instant beam straight ahead (very long reach). On hit: 18%, stuns. Press V once: it charges for 0.5 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Sky Line — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): a wide swing over your head that launches foes straight up. On hit: 16%, launches up. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.
Floor Line — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): a low sweep that hits both sides at once and sends foes low and out. On hit: 15%.

Must-See TV Headbutt — your screen flickers with a spiral, and every foe in front of you (long reach) who is looking at you shuffles toward you, hypnotised; then your screen-butt knocks away everyone right in front (short reach). Turn away to resist. On hit: 10%.

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Static Burst — Calls a robot spider that catches a foe and mauls them.
Short hop, fast fall and wall jumps. CLINGS to a wall for about 0.6 s (static) before he slides. Power Cut and Roll Cart jump-cancel.
Attack — three quick jabs just in front of him (short reach); the third one launches. On hit: 3 hits of 3%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Hop and Scream — hops up screaming, swatting over and ahead of him in an arc (short reach). On hit: 3.9%.
Cowering Kick — kicks low from a cower at their feet (short reach). On hit: 2.9%.
Flail — flails all round him in a panic, three times over (short reach). On hit: 2.4%.
Splinter Jab — jabs a splintered arm forward (short reach). On hit: 5.3%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Back Away — backs away swinging at whatever is behind him (short reach). On hit: 6.7%.
Jump Scare Up — jumps up and ahead of him with a scare (medium reach). On hit: 4.1%.
Panic Drop — drops in a panic and spikes whoever is below (short reach). On hit: 5.8%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Shaky Slap, 1.9%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Shaky Slap — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 1.9%.
Shove Away — shoves them away from him. On hit: 5.8%.
Run Past — runs past and flings them behind him. On hit: 6.3%.
Hop Up — hops up and sends them skyward, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.2%.
Duck Under — ducks and drops them on the floor. On hit: 4%.
Fraidy Dash — dashes forward, untouchable (medium reach), hitting anyone he runs into; three splinters drop behind as 8% traps. On hit: 12%.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Scream — he bolts almost straight up screaming, very fast, and every foe right next to him flinches as he goes (short reach). After it he falls helpless (no jump or attack) until he lands. On hit: no damage, stuns.
Dodge — no hit: slides back a little and can't be hit for a third of a second.

Dash · Splinter Scramble — squeaks and bolts 135 px BACKWARD; splinters burst off him at the spot he left, a round patch about 50 px wide that slows them (it costs him 4% and he is left open a moment). On hit: 13.5%, slows them. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

I Surrender! — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): waves a white flag over his head, from behind him to in front: the flag is the real hit and the stick is a weak one. On hit: 11.5%. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Knock on Wood — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): his knees knock together in fright, a wooden rattle: five tiny hits right around him, and the last knock throws them away. On hit: 11.2%.

Fainting Plank Flop — he squeaks in fright, then faints and topples forward like a felled plank, slamming everyone along the floor ahead of him (short reach) and knocking them down. Hold back while he squeaks to fall the other way. He lies there half a second after. Jump it, or stand back. On hit: 12%.

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Fraidy Stampede — Bolts forward, bolts back past the start, runs home, then faints.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. No cling and no cancel.
Attack — two quick squirts right in front of you (short reach). On hit: 2 hits of 2.2%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Cap Pop — pops her cap up over her head after a beat, a short burst; whoever it lifts hangs there a moment, ready for an up-air (medium reach). On hit: 4%.
Long Smear — squeezes a long thin smear of paste along the floor far ahead, quick; it sticks whoever it reaches (medium reach). On hit: 3.1%, roots them briefly.
Side Squirt — squirts a stream straight out of both ends of her at once, lifting whoever it hits (short reach). On hit: 4.1%.
Glob Toss — tosses a glob of paste a fair way ahead and above; it bumps them off level (short reach). On hit: 5.2%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Squeeze Flip — flips her whole tube up and over behind her in a rising arc, hurling whoever it catches up and away; her heaviest air hit (short reach). On hit: 6.5%.
Cap Flick — flicks her cap up and forward in an arc after a beat, tossing them ahead of her; the cap at the end hits harder (short reach). On hit: 4.7% with the cap (3.6% closer in).
Squeeze Out — hangs a beat, then squeezes a long straight stream of paste down under her; it shoves whoever it reaches down and away, stuck to the floor (medium reach). On hit: 5.9%, roots them.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Dab, 2.3%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Dab — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2.3%.
Squeeze Out — squeezes them out ahead like paste. On hit: 6.5%.
Tube Flip — flips them out behind her like a tube. On hit: 6.8%.
Cap Pop — pops them up off her cap, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.5%.
Stuck Down — sticks them to the floor with a smear. On hit: 4.3%.

Paste Trap — flings a sticky glob forward (long reach) and sets a sticky trap just ahead that roots whoever steps in. A foe your traps rooted can't be rooted by them again until a second after they are free. On hit: 8.1%, roots them in place.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Teleport — you vanish, aim with the arrows (up if none) and reappear a long way that way, untouchable while gone, hitting anyone right where you appear (short reach). After it you fall helpless (no jump or attack) until you land. On hit: 4.5%, slows them.

Root Trap — sets a sticky trap just ahead of you; the first foe to step on it is stuck. A foe your traps rooted can't be rooted by them again until a second after they are free. On hit: 5.4%, roots them in place.

Trap · Whole Tube — sets a trap just ahead of you; the first foe to step on it takes the hit. On hit: 14%, ices them over. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Spring Trap — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): a wide swing over your head that launches foes straight up. On hit: 12%, launches up. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.
Floor Trap — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): a low sweep that hits both sides at once and sends foes low and out. On hit: 11%.

Squeeze Rocket — one big squeeze rockets you the way you hold the arrows (long reach), ramming everyone you hit. Press again for one turn in the air. Hit a wall and you splat, stunned. A hit knocks you out of it. On hit: 7.2%.

Limit — taking 100% damage fills your Limit (it stays when you lose a stock). Then your neutral special, down special and neutral smash each get one powered use, in any order; all three are stronger. C: Minty Blast (a huge glob that goes through, and three traps). ↓ + C: Sticky Situation (three bigger root traps). V: Fresh Breath Field (a bigger mine that lasts longer, and a glob).

Reflector — hold Z: a pane in front of you turns enemy shots back at their owner, 1.8x faster and 1.3x the damage (at most 12%). It takes 7 frames from the press to come up, lasts up to 36 while Z is held, and leaves you open for 22 frames after (then 30 more before you can raise it again). It does nothing against melee or grabs. The strong fighters have this instead of a shield. Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
You're My Enemy Now! — Paste winds out round her in a sticky spiral, then flashes and bursts.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. No cling and no cancel: Slick Slide is her way in.
Attack — a quick swing at whoever is right in front of you (short reach). On hit: 3.3%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Uppity — throws a high-and-mighty swat up and over in an arc ahead (short reach). On hit: 3.7%.
Cheap Shot — goes low along the floor at their feet (short reach). On hit: 2.8%.
Tirade — rants in a circle, jabbing at everything near six times over (short reach). On hit: 2.1%.
Point Made — jabs a point forward, hard (short reach). On hit: 4.9%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Talk to the Elbow — puts an elbow into whoever is behind (short reach). On hit: 6.1%.
Raised Voice — raises a fist up and ahead (short reach). On hit: 3.6%.
Last Word — drops the last word on whoever is below and spikes them (short reach). On hit: 5.6%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Nag, 1.7%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Nag — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 1.7%.
Talk Over — talks over them and shoves them ahead. On hit: 5.6%.
Turn Around — turns on a heel and flings them behind. On hit: 6.1%.
Hear Me Out — hears nothing and sends them skyward, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.1%.
Shut Up — shuts them up flat on the floor. On hit: 3.9%.
Rapid Rant — three hard jabs right in front of you, and the last one launches (short reach). On hit: 3 hits of 5%.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Energy Boost — hold C to charge the boost (you sink slowly), let go and you leap up with an uppercut (short reach): the longer the charge, the higher you go, the harder it hits and the longer you run faster after; fully charged, it goes by itself. On hit: about half for a quick one, up to 5% (9% point-blank) fully charged.

Get Digging — you dig straight down at great speed and cannot be hit for a moment, then pop up in the same place: the burst of dirt stuns anyone right by the hole (short reach); you are stuck half out of the hole for a moment after. Only on the ground. On hit: 0%, stuns.

Beam · Point Blank Earful — fires an instant beam straight ahead (medium reach). On hit: 26%, weakens their hits. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Two-Second Climb — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): runs straight up the air the way she took the 500 steps, about 96 px in six frames, and is back on the floor before the move ends: her head is the hit, only on the way up, the same all the way. On hit: 20%. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Dirt Flinger — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): digs on the spot, and everything she digs out flies out BEHIND her in a low spray, as far as 116 px: nothing in front of her at all, so she has to turn her back on them. On hit: 18%.

Lost in Translation Bubble — you babble, then lob a garbled speech bubble in a slow arc at the nearest foe ahead (long reach); hold back while you babble to lob it at the nearest one behind. It pops on the first one it touches and swaps their left and right for 1.5 seconds. Dodge the arc. On hit: 8%.

Limit — taking 100% damage fills your Limit (it stays when you lose a stock). Then your neutral special, down special and neutral smash each get one powered use, in any order; all three are stronger. C: Rant Rampage (five jabs, longer reach, a harder last one). ↓ + C: Dig Deep (the ground erupts and stuns far wider). V: Endless Earful (farther and wider, then "and ANOTHER thing!").

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Get to the Top in 500 Steps — Goes still and charges up, then lands five blasts on a foe.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. No cling and no cancel.
Attack — a quick punch right in front of you (short reach). On hit: 2.8%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Strike Up — strikes her stick straight up, thin and quick, far over her head (medium reach). On hit: 3.8%, sets them burning.
Spark Stamp — stamps a spark at their toes, close and quick (short reach). On hit: 3.4%.
Burning Stick — holds her burning stick straight up and down, hitting above and below her at once (short reach). On hit: 4%, sets them burning.
Head Chop — chops her hot head down in an arc ahead of her, knocking them down and out (medium reach). On hit: 6.2%, sets them burning.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Flare Back — flares a burst high up behind her head that sends them up and away; her strongest air hit (medium reach). On hit: 7.6%.
Flame Lick — a lick of flame bursts far above and a little ahead of her, tossing them forward and up (medium reach). On hit: 4.4%, sets them burning.
Burnout — drops head-first, her flame sweeping round under her; it sends whoever is below out and down (short reach). On hit: 6.8%, sets them burning.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Scorch Tap, 2.2%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Scorch Tap — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2.2%.
Strike Toss — strikes them off ahead of her like a match. On hit: 7%.
Flick Away — flicks them away behind her. On hit: 7.5%.
Sparkler — sends them up like a sparkler. On hit: 5%.
Snuff Out — presses them flat like snuffing out a flame. On hit: 4.8%.
Triple Spark — throws three arcing fireballs in a spread (long reach). On hit: 6%, sets them burning.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Struck Match — the match flares while you aim with the arrows (up if none), then the flare jets you a long way that way, shoving whoever you pass; you take less damage for half a second. After it you fall helpless (no jump or attack) until you land. On hit: 4%.
Burn Trap — sets a burning trap just ahead of you that lasts about 5 seconds; anyone standing on it keeps getting hit. On hit: 6%, sets them burning.

Volley · Strike Anywhere — swings her head down and forward and strikes it on whoever is in front, like a match on a box: one short arc from over her head to low in front (about 55 px). On hit: 13.5%, sets them burning. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Like, OMG! — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): gasps, and her flame flares up with it: a big round flash at her head that shrinks back to a small flame, hardest and widest at the first instant. On hit: 10%, burns them. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Shake It Out — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): shakes herself out the way you shake out a match: her head goes from low in front, over the top, to low behind, and whoever it catches is thrown BEHIND her; it burns only at the start, in front, before the flame is out. On hit: 9.5%, burns them (in front only).

Lay the Fuse, Light It — for 2 seconds you lay a powder fuse along the ground behind you as you move; then a flame catches at your end, grows for a moment, and races back along it (as long as your fuse), burning whoever is standing on the line. Jump it, or get off the line. On hit: 6%, sets them burning.

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
FreeSmart Overdrive — The FreeSmart Van barrels across the stage from behind her, launching foes.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. No cling and no cancel: Spark Skim is her way in.
Attack — a jab just in front of you (short reach). On hit: 2.1%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Hands Up — throws both hands up in a wide arc over him (short reach). On hit: 6.5%.
Foot Stomp — stamps a foot down on the floor in front of theirs (medium reach). On hit: 5.7%.
Seriously Spin — spins round with his arms out, slapping everything near him five times over (short reach). On hit: 4.3%.
Fed Up Punch — throws a punch with everything he has left (medium reach). On hit: 10.8%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Fed-Up Elbow — drives an elbow back into whoever is behind him (short reach). On hit: 11.3%.
Jumpscare Up — jumps up yelling, hitting whoever is above (medium reach). On hit: 6.7%.
Ground Pound — comes down for a pound and spikes whoever is below; he can jump out of it once it hits (medium reach). On hit: 12.2%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Flick, 2.9%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Flick — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2.9%.
Aw, Seriously — sighs, picks them up and tosses them ahead. On hit: 7.7%.
Fed Up — has had enough and hurls them behind him. On hit: 8.2%.
Big Lift — lifts them overhead with a groan, ready for an up-air. On hit: 5.2%.
Sit On — sits on them with a sigh. On hit: 5.6%.
Aw Seriously — you pound the ground and a shockwave hits all around you (medium reach); in the air you slam down first. On hit: 10.1% up close, less farther out.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Jumpscare — a moment on guard: get hit in it and the hit does nothing, you jumpscare them ('Aw, seriously?'), springing up extra high, hitting them back and weakening their hits; if nothing comes, you hop up yelling, hitting foes beside you (short reach). Either way your next Attack (X) hits much harder. On hit: 6.4% (the jumpscare), or 4.6%, weakens their hits.
No! — no hit: about three-quarters of a second of armour; hits on you do less damage and far less knockback.

Root & blast · Aw Come On — roots you in place, then blasts everyone around you (short reach). On hit: 25%, stuns. Press V once: it charges for 0.5 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

No! — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): his other line: a big "NO!" over his head that shoves whoever touches it straight away from him; he will not be moved while he says it (armour for the first 10 frames). On hit: 18.4%. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Blank Stare — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): just stands there and smiles at whoever is in front of him, at eye level, a long way out; a foe who is looking back at him takes all of it, a foe who is looking away does not see it and is only bumped (nothing behind him). On hit: 15.6% on a foe who is facing him, 8% on a foe who is looking away.

Aw, Seriously? Shoulder Toss — a gloomy sigh, then you grab the nearest foe around you (short reach) and toss them over your shoulder, stripping their buffs, armour and stances. Step away during the sigh. On hit: 9.2%.

Reflector — hold Z: a pane in front of you turns enemy shots back at their owner, 1.8x faster and 1.3x the damage (at most 12%). It takes 7 frames from the press to come up, lasts up to 36 while Z is held, and leaves you open for 22 frames after (then 30 more before you can raise it again). It does nothing against melee or grabs. The strong fighters have this instead of a shield. Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Aw, Seriously! — Becomes a fight cloud that rolls forward, swallows foes, pummels them, then bursts.
Short hop, fast fall and wall jumps. CLINGS to a wall for about 0.6 s (he hangs on, annoyed) before he slides. Ground Pound and Stomp Along jump-cancel.
Attack — a quick hit just in front of him (short reach). On hit: 3.3%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Flame Lick — licks a tongue of flame up and over in an arc ahead (short reach). On hit: 3.9%.
Ember Trail — leaves a trail of embers along the floor at their feet (short reach). On hit: 3.2%.
Sparkler — spins like a sparkler, throwing sparks all round five times over (short reach). On hit: 2.4%.
Fireball Dash — dashes forward in a ball of fire (short reach). On hit: 5.7%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Hot Draft Back — blasts a backdraft out behind (short reach). On hit: 6.8%.
Flare Rise — flares up and ahead in a cone of fire (medium reach). On hit: 4.1%.
Meteor — drops like a little meteor and spikes whoever is below (short reach). On hit: 6.2%, burns them.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Singe, 1.9%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Singe — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 1.9%.
Hot Toss — tosses them ahead, still smoking. On hit: 6%.
Burn Back — whips round and flings them behind. On hit: 6.5%.
Heat Rise — sends them up on a hot draft, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.4%.
Snuff — snuffs them out flat on the floor. On hit: 4.1%.
Spark Jr. — flicks a fast little fireball forward in a low arc (medium reach). On hit: 7%, sets them burning.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Fire Whirl — you spin up in a rising spiral of flame: whoever you rise into is carried up with you (small hits), then flung out to the side at the top, burning. On hit: small hits on the way up, then 4%, sets them burning.
Flare Up — a ring of flame bursts around him (short reach). On hit: 3%, sets them burning.

Lunge · Tantrum Flare — throws himself on his back and kicks: four fast low kicks just in front of him, the first three hold the foe in place and the last flares and launches (he is left lying there afterwards). On hit: 18%, sets them burning on the last kick. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Blows His Top — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): loses his temper: the flame on his head shoots up like a rocket and bursts high over him into a ring of sparks; the rocket is a light hit that holds them for the burst, and the burst burns. On hit: 12.5% with both (3% from the rocket, 9.5% from the burst), and burns them. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Kicks Up a Fuss — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): in a temper he kicks hot embers out on both sides of him, and they lie glowing on the floor a step away for a moment; whoever is on them, or steps on them while they glow, is burned and sent out low. On hit: 11%, and burns them.

Calls In Firey for Backup — he yells for Firey, who drops in beside him, grows one big burning fireball in his hand and throws it the way Jr. faces (very long reach), then leaves; hold back while he yells to send it the other way. Hit Firey before he throws to send him off early. Jump the fireball. On hit: 12%, sets them burning.

Limit — taking 100% damage fills your Limit (it stays when you lose a stock). Then your neutral special, down special and neutral smash each get one powered use, in any order; all three are stronger. C: Tantrum Fireball (five bursts and a big fireball). ↓ + C: Inferno Ring (a huge ring that launches and burns longer). V: Supernova Tantrum (the last kick is a big flare).

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Spark Jr. — Ten sparks fly out all round him, twice.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. No cling and no cancel.
Attack — a quick hit right in front of you (short reach). On hit: 3%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Frond Rise — rises with its fronds up and over in a high arc ahead (medium reach). On hit: 5.6%.
Creeper Trip — trips them with a creeper along the floor, carrying it a step ahead (medium reach). On hit: 4.5%.
Frond Whirl — whirls its fronds round it, clipping everything near five times over (short reach). On hit: 3.4%.
Frond Swing — swings a frond straight ahead, and the tip of the frond hits harder; hit, and it can jump out of it (medium reach). On hit: 11.2% at the tip (8.6% closer in).

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Frond Back — swings a frond back at whoever is behind (medium reach). On hit: 10.2%.
Sprout Rise — sprouts up and ahead in a rising cone of leaves (medium reach). On hit: 5.3%.
Spore Drop — drops like a heavy spore pod and spikes whoever is below; it can jump out of it once it hits (medium reach). On hit: 10.8%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Tendril Squeeze, 2.8%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Tendril Squeeze — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2.8%.
Vine Heave — heaves them ahead on a vine. On hit: 7.9%.
Whip Around — whips a vine round and flings them behind. On hit: 8.3%.
Grow Up — grows them skyward, ready for an up-air. On hit: 5.3%.
Root Down — roots them to the floor and presses them flat. On hit: 5.5%.
Photosynthesis — whips a vine just ahead of you (short reach) and heals you 14% over about a second. On hit: 8%.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Pole Jump — hold C to bend the pole (you sink slowly), let go and it throws you up: the longer you bend it, the higher you go, up to extra high; fully bent, it goes by itself. You hit anyone beside you as you spring (short reach). On hit: about half for a quick one, up to 6% fully bent, roots them in place.
Regen Stance — no hit: heals you 23% over about 2 seconds (a hit pauses it), with a moment of armour.

Shockwave · Full Bloom — a shockwave bursts out around you (medium reach) after a short wind-up. On hit: 17%, drains them. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Overhead Press — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): after working out: he plants his feet and presses his fronds up over his head like a barbell; he is braced the whole lift (armour: hits on him do less and push far less), and whoever is over him is thrown up. On hit: 14.5%. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Soak It Up — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): spreads his fronds out flat along the floor on both sides, soaking up the light; whoever they catch is sent out low, and Fern heals 4% for each foe caught. On hit: 13%, and heals Fern 4% a foe.

Spores Sprout Snapping Fernlings — you scatter spores ahead (medium reach); three fernlings sprout one after another from half a second later, and for 4 seconds each lashes everyone beside it once a second, and you heal 1% a second near them. Stomp or hit one to uproot it. On hit: 4% a lash.

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Photosynthesis — Winds the nearest foe in vines, lashes them, and heals himself.
Short hop, fast fall and wall jumps. CLINGS to a wall for about 0.8 s (its vines grip) before it slides. Frond Swing and Spore Drop jump-cancel once they hit.
Attack — fires a straight shot (reaches the whole stage); anyone right in front of you gets the swing instead. On hit: 2.2%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Knuckle Rise — raises the ruler up and over in a high arc ahead (medium reach). On hit: 3.9%.
Inch Along — slides the ruler along the floor at their feet (short reach). On hit: 3%.

Straight Shot — the same as X on the ground (fires a straight shot), in the air too: the aerials are X with a direction. No neutral air: the shot is the identity ("Keep the spit", for Puffball, was the same call).
Straight Edge — swings the straight edge out ahead and a little down (medium reach). On hit: 5.8%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Rear Measure — swings the ruler back at whoever is behind (short reach). On hit: 6.5%.
Ruler Up — stands the ruler up and ahead in a rising cone (medium reach). On hit: 3.6%.
Plumb Line — drops the ruler straight down and spikes whoever is below (short reach). On hit: 6.2%.

Draw a Line — draws a line and sends them across it, ahead. On hit: 5.7%.
Reverse Scale — flips the scale and flings them behind. On hit: 6.1%.
Raise the Bar — raises the bar and sends them skyward, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4%.
Flatten — flattens them against the floor. On hit: 3.7%.
Measure Twice — fires a fast, straight shot (reaches the whole stage). On hit: 7.7%.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Knuckle Rap — you hook the nearest ledge in reach with the ruler's end and pull yourself up onto it; anyone along the ruler is rapped and pulled in. Nothing in reach: only a short hop. On hit: 5.2%, strips armour and stances.
Straight Edge — no hit: you hold the ruler up flat for a third of a second and any shot that reaches you is turned back.

Beam · Cut Once — fires an instant beam straight ahead (reaches the whole stage). On hit: 15%, weakens their hits, launches far. Sky Line — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): a wide swing over your head that launches foes straight up. On hit: 14%, launches up. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.
Floor Line — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): a low sweep that hits both sides at once and sends foes low and out. On hit: 13%.

Tick Mark, Then Cut — you plant a tick mark at your feet; for 1.5 seconds a dotted line joins it to you wherever you go (long reach), then it snaps into a cutting edge where it lies. Jump the line. On hit: 11.2%.

Limit — taking 100% damage fills your Limit (it stays when you lose a stock). Then your neutral special, down special and neutral smash each get one powered use, in any order; all three are stronger. C: Cut Once (a long piercing cut follows the shot). ↓ + C: Ruled Out (held up longer, with a swipe that weakens). V: Ruled Line (a wider line that snaps back and stuns).

Gutter Sweep — sweeps the gutter along the floor at their feet (medium reach). On hit: 5.4%.
Sidewalk Spin — spins like a loose paving stone, clipping everything near him four times over (short reach). On hit: 4.3%.
Crack Slam — slams his slab down in front of him with a crack (medium reach). On hit: 10%.

Slab Up — tips his slab up on end and raps it against whoever is above (medium reach). On hit: 6.5%.
Pavement Drop — drops flat like a paving stone and spikes whoever is below; he can jump out of it once it hits (short reach). On hit: 11.7%.

Heave — heaves them up on his edge, ready for an up-air. On hit: 5.9%.
Fresh Pour — lays them flat in wet cement. On hit: 6.3%.
Pavement Slam — an armoured body-slam right in front of you as you lunge a step forward (short reach). On hit: 10.5%, stuns.

Step on a Crack — you stamp, and a crack zigzags along the ground ahead (long reach), opening up for a moment. Once it is open, for 4 seconds any foe who steps on it trips and is knocked down (once each). Hop it. On hit: 8.4%.

Attack — a jab just in front of you (short reach). On hit: 4%.

Drift Up — floats up and over in a wide arc ahead (short reach). On hit: 4.1%.
Pin Prick — pricks the floor at their feet with a hiss; the point of the pin hits harder (short reach). On hit: 4.1% at the point (3.2% closer in).
Hiss Spin — spins hissing out air all round, clipping everything near four times over (short reach). On hit: 2.4%.
Air Jet — jets forward on a burst of air (short reach). On hit: 5.9%.

Lift Off — lifts off up and ahead in a squeaky cone (short reach). On hit: 4.1%.

Puff Away — puffs them away ahead. On hit: 5.9%.
Let Go — lets go of the air and sends them behind. On hit: 6.4%.
Inflate — inflates them skyward, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.4%.
Pop Flat — pops them flat against the floor. On hit: 4.2%.
Air Leak — a jet of air zips you forward and shoves a foe right in front of you (short reach). On hit: 10%, launches far.

Deflate & Drift — no hit: you deflate and drift upward, untouchable for about a quarter of a second.

Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. Deflate can be jump-cancelled once it hits. No cling: it floats.

Dish Raise — raises his antenna up and over in a high arc ahead of him (medium reach). On hit: 7.7%.
Tread Roll — rolls his treads over their feet, carrying him a step ahead (medium reach). On hit: 6.2%.
Radar Sweep — sweeps his antenna round him in a full circle five times over (short reach). On hit: 4.6%.
Cannon Arm — fires his arm forward like a cannon (medium reach). On hit: 12.7%.

Beep Up — fires his antenna straight up in a long beep; the tip of the antenna hits harder (medium reach). On hit: 9% at the tip (7% lower down).
Tank Drop — drops like a tank and spikes whoever is below; he can jump out of it once it hits (medium reach). On hit: 15.8%.

Conveyor — carries them along on his belt and lets go ahead. On hit: 10.3%.
Reverse Gear — throws it into reverse and sends them back behind him. On hit: 10.8%.
Lift Arm — lifts them overhead on his arm, ready for an up-air. On hit: 7%.
Compactor — presses them flat under his tread. On hit: 7.4%.
Antenna Spring — his antenna springs out all around him (short reach), launching foes straight up and bouncing teammates high. On hit: 9.6%.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Beep — the tank braces, then climbs straight up slowly, armoured the whole way (hits do not stop him), steered a little with the arrows; his antenna fires a beep up and forward as he starts (very long reach). On hit: 4.8%, stuns.
Tank Armour — no hit: braces for about three-quarters of a second; hits on him do less damage and barely push him.

Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Low Volley — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): a low sweep that hits both sides at once and sends foes low and out. On hit: 17%.

Walk against the belt or jump off it. A hit on him stops it all. On hit: 13.2%.

Attack — a quick hit right in front of you (short reach). On hit: 3.8%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Profile Pic — throws a photo up and over in an arc ahead of him (medium reach). On hit: 4.3%.
Tag Trip — trips them with a dangling tag at their feet (short reach). On hit: 3.3%, weakens them.
Sticker Sheet — spins with a sheet of stickers, clipping everything near him four times over (short reach). On hit: 2.7%.
Price Hike — hikes a price straight out ahead of him (short reach). On hit: 6.5%.

Mark Up — marks the price up and ahead of him (medium reach). On hit: 5.1%.
Clearance — comes down on a clearance sale and spikes whoever is below (short reach). On hit: 6.5%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Tag Tug, 2%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.

Checkout — rings them up and sends them ahead. On hit: 6.5%.
Return Policy — returns them behind him. On hit: 7%.
Mark Up High — marks them up skyward, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.7%.
Marked Down — marks them down flat on the floor. On hit: 4.4%.

Price Tag — slaps a sticker on the nearest foe (medium reach): a small pop-up, and it marks them to take more from your hits (30% more) for 5 seconds. On hit: 4%. Your smash launches a tagged foe farther.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Paid in Full — a price tag on a string catches the nearest ledge in reach and reels you up onto it; anyone on the string is hit and pulled in, and pays you. Nothing in reach: only a short hop. On hit: 6%, heals you 3%.
OVERPRICED! — no hit: the nearest foe (medium reach) gets overpriced, which weakens their hits for 3 seconds.

Lunge · Sticker Shock — lunges forward (medium reach) and hits the first foe it touches. On hit: 14%, launches a foe wearing his Price Tag a little farther. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Remember Me Now? — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): holds his own picture frame up over his head and turns it to face them, so they cannot miss him: whoever it meets is tagged with his Price Tag for 3 seconds (his hits on them land harder, and his smash launches them farther). On hit: 12%, and tags them for 3 s. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Now You See Me — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): turns edge-on, paper-thin, so for a moment nothing can touch him (the first 8 frames of the move), and his frame swings round as he turns, clipping whoever is in front of him and then whoever is behind. On hit: 11%.

Edge-On Slice — you turn sideways, paper-thin, then glide straight ahead (medium reach), on the ground or in the air, slicing every foe you pass and tagging them again with your Price Tag. Hold back as you turn to glide the other way. Shots pass through you while you glide; a swing still stops you. Jump it. On hit: 9%.

Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. No cling and no cancel.

The neutral attack, aimed that way.

Leaf Whirl — whirls every leaf he has round him in a wide slow ring, twice over (short reach). On hit: 3.1%.
Timber Fall — topples forward like a felled tree, from high above down to ahead of him, crashing on as he goes; a slow heavy hit (medium reach). On hit: 10.6%.

On hit: 21.8%, always toward the middle of the stage.

Leg Up the Wall — a leg hooks over the nearest ledge in reach and pulls them up onto it, with a jump back; anyone along the leg is kicked, pulled in and stunned. Nothing in reach: only a hop. On hit: 7%, stuns them.
The Bait — they flop down with a fake boo-boo, and the first foe to come close is tripped by the other cherry (short reach). On hit: 6%, knocks them down.

Trap · All the Way to Mars — sets a trap just ahead of you; the first foe to step on it takes the hit. On hit: 23%, knocks them down. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Spring Trap — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): a wide swing over your head that launches foes straight up. On hit: 20%, launches up. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.
Floor Trap — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): a low sweep that hits both sides at once and sends foes low and out. On hit: 19%.

Cherry Pick — a command grab: they wind back, then the stem lashes straight out ahead (long reach) and snags the first foe it touches, even through a shield, and slams them into the floor. A miss leaves them open. On hit: 9%, knocks them down.

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Play Dirty — A slick of oil runs out along the floor ahead of them; hop it.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. Slick Slide can be jump-cancelled when it ends. No cling.
Attack — a leafy punch just in front of her (short reach). On hit: 2.3%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Four-Leaf Up — flicks a four-leaf clover up over her head (short reach). On hit: 4.4%.
Clover Trip — slips a clover stem under their feet (short reach). On hit: 3.5%.
Lucky Spin — spins with her leaves out, clipping everything near twice (short reach). On hit: 3.4%.
Lucky Strike — a lucky punch ahead in the air (short reach). On hit: 6%.

rows.key: turn round + X in the air
rows.text: Lucky Break — breaks lucky behind her, a leafy backhand (short reach). On hit: 7.8%.
Butterfly Up — sends a butterfly straight up past her head (medium reach). On hit: 4.3%.
Four-Leaf Drop — drops like a four-leaf clover onto whoever is below (short reach). On hit: 7%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Leaf Tickle, 1.9%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Leaf Tickle — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 1.9%.
Lucky Toss — tosses them ahead for luck. On hit: 6%.
Wind at My Back — catches the wind and blows them off behind her. On hit: 6.4%.
Lucky Wind — lifts them on the lucky wind, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.2%.
Meant for Me — turns the luck on them and puts them down. On hit: 4.4%.
Butterflies — calls four butterflies that drift ahead (long reach) and catch a shot each in front of her; a foe who touches one hits weaker. On hit: 4%, weakens them.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Lucky Wind — no hit: the wind lifts her high and she runs faster for three-quarters of a second; keep holding C and from the top the wind carries her slowly and far, turned with the arrows. X or letting go ends it. No jump back.
Meant for Me — no hit: for half a second her luck turns the next hit away from her, and it lands on whoever threw it instead.

Roller · Lucky Break — bends down to pick up a four-leaf clover (12 frames) and stands straight up into whoever is in front: a short hit in front and above, about 40 px. On hit: 18%, knocks them down. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

On hit: 14%. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Wishbone — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): she snaps a wishbone and the two halves skid out along the floor both ways; whoever a half hits is sent out low and is out of luck: their hits do a little less (up to 6%), wearing off over about 18 s, because her luck is taken from the others. On hit: 13%, and curses them (bad luck).

Lucky Leaf Pinwheel — she spins up like her own four leaves, then drifts along the floor (long reach), catching whoever the pinwheel touches and carrying them in front of her; the fourth hit flings them, and each foe flung lends her their luck: Attack Up for 3 s. Hold back during the spin to drift the other way. In the air (once a jump) she falls as she drifts. A hit on her ends it. On hit: 4 hits of 3% (the last flings).

Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.

Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. Butterfly Ride can be jump-cancelled when it ends. No cling.
Attack — a knuckle punch just in front of him (short reach). On hit: 2.3%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.

Leg Sweep — sweeps their legs out from under them (short reach). On hit: 6.5%.
Hothead Spin — spins with his temper, clipping everything near him twice (short reach). On hit: 3.7%.
Lariat — swings a clothesline arm straight ahead (medium reach). On hit: 9.2%.

The neutral attack, aimed that way.

Stuck Together Like Fridge Magnets — a pulse magnetises the nearest foe in clear sight (long reach). For the next 1.5 s they are dragged into the nearest other foe and stuck to them, both rooted; with no other foe they are just rooted. A wall or a gap in the floor stops the drag. On hit: 4%, then 6% to each when they clash; stunned 0.4 s.

Reflector — hold Z: a pane in front of you turns enemy shots back at their owner, 1.8x faster and 1.3x the damage (at most 12%). It takes 7 frames from the press to come up, lasts up to 36 while Z is held, and leaves you open for 22 frames after (then 30 more before you can raise it again). It does nothing against melee or grabs. The strong fighters have this instead of a shield. Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Like Poles Repel — Spins a foe round her like a planet, clacking her horseshoe shut, then slings them.

Attack — a punch just in front of them (short reach). On hit: 3.1%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Badge Up — raises the badge up over their head in an arc (short reach). On hit: 6.5%.
Cuff-Tap — snaps a cuff on the ankle with a quick sweep along the floor; it roots them a moment (short reach). On hit: 4.2%, roots them.
Patrol Spin — spins on patrol, clipping everything near her twice (short reach). On hit: 3.4%.
Barrier Jab — jabs a pane of her barrier straight ahead (short reach). On hit: 9%.

Lockdown Drop — drops in lockdown onto whoever is below her (short reach). On hit: 9.8%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Cuff Click, 2.5%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Cuff Click — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2.5%.
Cuff and Toss — cuffs them and tosses them off ahead. On hit: 7.2%.
Escorted Out — escorts them out behind her at speed. On hit: 7.6%.
Barrier Step — springs them up off a pane of barrier, ready for an up-air. On hit: 5%.
Restrained — restrains them flat on the floor. On hit: 5.4%.
Cuffing Dash — a short dash (short reach); the first foe it touches is cuffed and rooted for about 0.6 seconds, and can mash out a little sooner. On hit: 8%.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Barrier Step — no hit: up to three springs off panes of their own barrier: press C again in the air for the next one, each a little lower, steered with the arrows; untouchable for a moment at the start.
Precision Finding — no hit: the logo glows and locks on the nearest foe for 5 seconds; their hits on that foe land 30% harder. Tracking another foe moves the mark.

On hit: 15%, puts a see-through wall up behind them that crushes them as they are launched into it, launches far. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

On hit: 12.5%, and tracks them for 2 s. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Padded Cell — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): the cell they locked Knife in: a padded see-through wall springs up out of the floor a step away on each side of them, and whoever it rises under is bounced back in toward MeTag and held a moment. On hit: 11.5%, and bounces them in toward MeTag.

Barrier Clap — their logo glows as they track the nearest foe (long reach), then two see-through panes rise either side of that foe, shimmer a moment and clap together. Step out, or jump it, before they close. Needs a floor either side. On hit: 11%; stunned 0.4 s.

Barriers — Finds a foe and bounces them between glass barrier walls.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. Barrier Push can be jump-cancelled when it ends. No cling.
Attack — a punch just in front of them (short reach). On hit: 3%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Nozzle Up — swings the vacuum nozzle up over their head (short reach). On hit: 5.4%.
Hose Trip — whips the vacuum hose along the floor to trip them (medium reach). On hit: 4.7%.
Suction Spin — spins the hose round her, clipping everything near twice (short reach). On hit: 3.9%.
Pod Pop — pops a pod out ahead of them with a thump (short reach). On hit: 8.3%.

Pop Corn — pops like a kernel straight up through whoever is above (medium reach). On hit: 5.2%.
Kernel Drop — drops like a heavy kernel onto whoever is below (short reach). On hit: 9.2%.

Pod Out — pops them into a pod and out ahead of her. On hit: 7.8%.
The Jig Is Up — sucks them in and blows them out behind her. On hit: 8.2%.
Pop-Up Toss — pops them up like a kernel, ready for an up-air. On hit: 5.2%.
Vacuum Down — vacuums them flat against the floor. On hit: 5.4%.
Ghost Vacuum — rooted, sucks in every foe nearby, and whoever reaches the nozzle pops out in a pod (long reach). On hit: 8%, roots them.

Pop-Up — hold C while the kernel heats (you sink slowly), let go and you burst straight up like a popping kernel: the longer you held, the higher you go and the harder it hits anyone right beside you (short reach); then you run faster for three-quarters of a second. On hit: up to 9%, knocks them down.
Quick Fix — no hit: kneels and tinkers, mending about 10% over a second; a hit interrupts it.

Jack-in-the-Box — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): a jury-rigged jack-in-the-box: she sets it down a step in front of her and cranks it, and a spring-loaded glove pops straight up out of it, from the floor to well over her head; whoever is over the box, on the floor or in the air, is popped straight up. On hit: 18%. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Short Circuit — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): jams two wires into the floor and sparks run out along it both ways, about 125 px; whoever they reach is jolted stiff for a moment (stunned, half a second) and only nudged, not thrown. On hit: 13%, and stuns them for half a second.

Jury-Rigged Wind-Up Walker — winds the key on a walker of scrap that sets itself down just ahead and clanks along the floor (long reach); it clamps the first foe it meets, zaps them three times, then pops. Silver Sweep — sweeps his bowl along the floor into their feet (medium reach). On hit: 5%.
Golden Whirl — whirls round on his handle, clipping everything near him twice (short reach). On hit: 4.4%.
Spoonful — a heavy spoonful straight ahead; one of his hardest forward hits, hardest with the bowl at the far end (medium reach). On hit: 11.2% with the bowl (8.5% with the handle).

Handle Up — drives his handle straight up past his head (medium reach). On hit: 5.8%.
Gold Drop — drops bowl-first onto whoever is below; he can jump out of it once it hits (medium reach). On hit: 10%.

On hit: 16%, and weakens them for 2 s.

On hit: 8%, then bought for 2 s.

Eject Kick — ejects a foot low along the floor into their ankles (short reach). On hit: 4.7%.

Leap of Faith — a rope swing: the rope catches the nearest ledge in reach and swings her up onto it, with a jump back, and she runs faster for three-quarters of a second; anyone on the rope is hit, pulled in and knocked down. Nothing in reach: only a short hop. On hit: 7%, knocks them down.
Record — no hit: her red button lights, and the biggest hit anyone near her takes until she plays it back goes on the tape.

Beam · Solo Track — fires an instant beam straight ahead (long reach). On hit: 20%, stuns. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Sky Line — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): a wide swing over your head that launches foes straight up. On hit: 18%, launches up. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.
Floor Line — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): a low sweep that hits both sides at once and sends foes low and out. On hit: 16%.

Rewind Them Two Seconds — her reels spin up, then a length of tape reaches out to the nearest foe standing on the stage (long reach) and winds them back to where they stood 2 s ago, never off the stage. A hit on her snaps the tape. On hit: 8%; stunned 0.4 s where they land.

Shield — hold Z: a bubble in your colour blocks every hit and shot (a grab still gets you). It shrinks as it takes damage and refills when you let go; at zero it breaks and you are stunned for 2 s. It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Eject! — Tape sticks to everyone it touches, reels them in, then the EJECT button throws them out.
Short hop, fast fall and wall jumps. CLINGS to a wall for about 0.7 s (the tape sticks) before she slides. Stop Button and Fast Forward jump-cancel; Fast Forward keeps its speed.
Spout Peck — she pecks forward with her spout, just in front of her (short reach). On hit: 2.3%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Lid Flip — pops her lid up in a high arc over her head (short reach). On hit: 5.4%.
Spout Poke — pokes her spout out along the floor at their feet (medium reach). On hit: 4.9%.
Boil Over — boils over in a ring of steam that scalds everything near her twice (short reach). On hit: 3.6%, burns them.

Spout Blast — blasts a jet of steam straight ahead from her spout; the steam right at the spout is the hottest and hits harder (medium reach). On hit: 8.8% right at the spout (6.3% further out), burns them.

Whistle Up — lets out a whistle straight up that lifts whoever is above (medium reach). On hit: 5.2%.
Kettle Drop — drops like a full kettle onto whoever is below; she can jump out of it once it hits (medium reach). On hit: 9.4%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Mama Pat, 2.5%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Mama Pat — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2.5%.
Serving Up — serves them off ahead on her tray. On hit: 7.4%.
Poured Out — tips them out behind her like a pour. On hit: 7.8%.
Whistle Blow — blows a whistle and sends them up on the steam, ready for an up-air. On hit: 5%.
Mama's Lap — sits them down hard in her lap. On hit: 5.4%.
Hors d'Oeuvres — skids her tray along the floor (medium reach); feeds a teammate 6%; a foe who turns it down makes her boil over. On hit: 6%, and no specials or smash for 1.5s.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Steam Jet — hold C to build steam (she sinks slowly), let go and the jet throws her up, and a little the way she steers: the longer she held, the higher she goes; the jet scalds whoever is under her and pushes them DOWN (short reach). On hit: up to 4%, burns them.
Mama's Gotcha! — hugs the foe right in front of her in a firm hold, then sets them down (short reach). On hit: 8%, held.

Shockwave · Blow Her Lid — a shockwave bursts out around you (medium reach) after a short wind-up. On hit: 23%, sets them burning. Costs you 4%. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Spout Off — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): she tips her head back and lets off a jet of steam from her spout, up and forward on a slant; whoever it hits is thrown up and away and scalded (burned). On hit: 16%, and burns them. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.

Sit Down, Dear — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): the den mother: she pats the floor firmly on both sides of her, and whoever is right beside her is sat down (knocked off their feet) and only nudged. On hit: 15%, and knocks them down.

Pour a Fresh Cup — tips her spout, then pours a scalding stream ahead for 1 s that droops to the floor (medium reach); on the ground or in the air (once a jump, over the stage). Hold up or down to raise or lower it. Foes it splashes burn and are nudged back; teammates it splashes heal. A hit on her stops it. On hit: up to 12% (six splashes of 2%), burns; teammates heal 1.5% a splash.

It comes up 4 frames after the press and costs 5 to drop; jump leaves it at once, and it cannot be raised in the air. Out of it: grab 28 frames after you raise it (a miss leaves you open), jab 8, down tilt 12, smash 22, special 30 (the bubble drops when the move starts). Tap Z while moving on the ground to sprint instead (1.4x your run until you stop, turn, jump, attack or get hit); if Z is still held 6 frames after the press, it is a hold and comes up then.
Mama's Gotcha! — Hugs a foe and sits them down to dinner for one, then boils over.
Short hop, fast fall and wall jumps. CLINGS to a wall for about 0.7 s (the steam holds her) before she slides. Kettle Drop and Steam Skate jump-cancel.
Attack — a punch just in front of her (short reach). On hit: 2.5%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Stuffing Uppercut — swings a paw up and over her head, stuffing flying (short reach). On hit: 5%.
Bear Trip — sticks a stubby foot out low and trips them (short reach). On hit: 4.4%.
Berserk Flail — flails every limb in a fury, clipping everything near three times over (short reach). On hit: 2.8%.
Paint Slug — fires a point-blank paintball straight ahead; it hits harder right at the muzzle than further out (medium reach). On hit: 7% point-blank (5.2% further out).

rows.text: Recoil Kick — kicks out behind her with the recoil of the gun (short reach). On hit: 8%.
Skyward Shot — fires a paintball straight up, popping whoever is above (medium reach). On hit: 4.9%.
Plop Down — plops down on whoever is below with all her stuffing (short reach). On hit: 7.8%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Stuffing Pull, 2.5%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Stuffing Pull — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2.5%.
Point Blank — shoves the gun in their face and fires them off ahead. On hit: 7.2%.
Bear Hug Fling — hugs them furiously, then flings them behind her. On hit: 7.6%.
Toss Up — tosses them overhead like a toy, ready for an up-air. On hit: 5%.
Knees Down — drops to her knees and takes them with her. On hit: 5%.
Paint Gun — a fast paintball straight ahead that pops them up (very long reach); a 7th shot without a rest leaves her tired. On hit: 5%.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Respect THIS! — she rises in a flurry of wild punches: whoever she rises into is carried up with her (small hits), then punched away at the top, and she runs faster for three-quarters of a second. On hit: small hits on the way up, then 5%.
Front of the Crowd — a shoulder barge forward that knocks over everyone in the way (medium reach). On hit: 6%.

Root & blast · Rage Room — roots you in place, then blasts everyone around you (short reach). On hit: 24%, knocks them down. Breaks shields. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Rooted Uppercut — press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled; the same charge): a wide swing over your head that launches foes straight up. On hit: 21%, launches up. A foe touching you (not below) is hit too.
Rooted Sweep — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): a low sweep that hits both sides at once and sends foes low and out. On hit: 20%.

Paint Grenade, Then Paintballs — lobs a paint grenade in an arc at the nearest foe ahead (long reach) that splats wide where it lands (very long reach). Foes caught are painted for 4 s and take 25% more from her Paint Gun. Hold back during the wind-up to lob it behind. On hit: 7%, painted for 4 s.

Yes!!! Smash!!! — Smashes a plate, a TV, then the table in a rage room, each bigger.
Short hop, fast fall and a plain wall jump. Dive for Cover can be jump-cancelled when it ends. No cling.
There's More! — two kicks from one press, one after the other, just in front of them (short reach). On hit: 2 hits of 3.6%.
The neutral attack, aimed that way.
Stilt Up — stretches one leg up like a stilt over their head (short reach). On hit: 5.3%.
Spaggers! — flicks a clump of spaghetti far along the floor; it tangles and roots whoever it touches (medium reach). On hit: 2.9%, tangles and roots them.
Confetti Spin — spins in a burst of confetti, clipping everything near twice (short reach). On hit: 3.8%.
Extended Kick — extends a leg out for a kick a long way ahead; the foot at the end hits harder (medium reach). On hit: 7% with the foot (5.3% closer in).

rows.text: Backwards Kick — extends the other leg out behind them (short reach). On hit: 9%.
Bridge Kick — stretches both legs straight up and kicks past their head (medium reach). On hit: 7.4%.
Stomp the Gap — stretches their legs and stomps down on whoever is below (short reach). On hit: 7.9%.
Grab — reaches a short way ahead on the ground; hold on and press or hold X to pummel (Confetti Pop, 2%), or a direction to throw. No hit: it is a hold.
Confetti Pop — a quick pummel while you hold them. On hit: 2%.
Cheer Toss — cheers and tosses them off ahead. On hit: 6.1%.
There's More! — kicks them once, then again, off behind. On hit: 6.5%.
Bridge the Gap — stretches up with them and lets go, ready for an up-air. On hit: 4.3%.
Gotcha! — tackles them flat to the floor. On hit: 4.5%.

Cheer Factory! — no hit: a confetti pulse; allies within about 260 px heal 3% and run faster for 2 seconds, more for Goo, Balloon, Nickel (II), Test Tube. Alone, Bot runs faster; their next hit does 30% more damage.
The neutral special, aimed that way.

Bridge the Gap! — their legs stretch out to the nearest ledge in reach and pull them up onto it; anyone along the legs is hit, pulled in and stunned. Nothing in reach: the legs stretch straight up like stilts, they hang, then the legs snap back as a stomp (short reach). On hit: 4.5% (the legs), 8.1% (the stomp), stuns them.
Gotcha! — lunges at the nearest foe, tackles them and holds them for about a second; they cannot use specials for 2 seconds, and Bot takes no damage while holding (medium reach). On hit: 3.6%, held.

Hop · The One and Only! — hops at the nearest foe (long reach) and stomps down on them. On hit: 16%, stuns. Press V once: it charges for 0.4 s, then goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Up smash: press ↑ and V together (the jump is cancelled); down smash: press ↓ and V together.

Ground Pound — press ↓ and V together (on a platform the smash wins over dropping through; the same charge): a low sweep that hits both sides at once and sends foes low and out. On hit: 13%.

Jump it. Hold back during the wind-up to boot it the other way. On hit: 7.2%, pops them up.
